panelAppForm.tipDomainChange: Changing the address domain generates a new key, and the tool needs to receive it.

panelAppForm.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.
panelAppForm.keyRotateConfirmDesc: The current key stops working immediately: the tool rejects tokens until it receives the new key. Only generate one when you are going to add the new key to the tool right away.
panelAppForm.keyRotated: New key generated. Copy it and add it to the tool: the previous one is no longer valid.
panelAppForm.keyCreatedNow: Key generated. Copy the public key and add it to the tool.
panelAppForm.keyUnreadable: Unreadable key: the server can no longer use this app's key (for example, after moving to another server). Generate a new key and add it to the tool.
panelAppForm.keyPendingNew: The key is created when you save. Then open the app's settings again to copy the public key and add it to the tool.
panelAppForm.keyMissing: This app does not have a key yet (for example, a company brought over from another server). Generate the key and add it to the tool.
panelAppForm.domainChangeDesc: The address changes from {from} to {to}. On save, the signed token key changes: the current one stops working and the tool at the new address needs to receive the new key, which appears here after saving.
panelAppForm.verifyTitle: How the tool verifies the token
panelAppForm.verifyIntro: Pass these instructions on to whoever maintains the tool.
panelAppForm.verifyStep1: The token arrives in the address, in place of {variable}. It has two parts separated by a dot: the data and the signature.
panelAppForm.verifyStep2: Verify the signature (Ed25519) of the first part, exactly as it arrived, with the public key above. If it does not match, reject the token.
panelAppForm.verifyStep3: Decode the first part (base64url containing JSON text) and check the fields below.
panelAppForm.verifyCheckIss: must be a panel address: {value} (add the panel's other addresses, if any)
panelAppForm.verifyCheckExp: the token's expiry time, in seconds; allow up to 60 seconds of clock skew
panelAppForm.verifyCheckIat: reject the token if this time is more than 60 seconds in the future
panelAppForm.verifyCheckJti: optional: reject a token that has already been used
panelAppForm.verifyFieldUser: who opened it: id, name, email, profile and whether they are a restricted user
panelAppForm.verifyFieldContact: the contact, when opened from the contact or the ticket: id and, without the {masked} flag, name, phone number, email and company
panelAppForm.verifyFieldTicket: the ticket, when opened from the ticket: id and protocol
panelAppForm.verifyFieldMasked: true when the user is restricted or the panel is in presentation mode: only the ids are sent
panelAppForm.verifyIdentityTip: To recognize the person, use {userId} together with {tenantId} and {iss}: the name and email are for display only, because whoever manages the panel can change them.
panelAppForm.verifyExamplePhp: PHP 7.2 or newer, with the sodium extension.
panelAppForm.verifyExampleNote: The examples already include the address of this tool and of this panel.
panelAppForm.sessionTipFragment: Prefer receiving the token after the # (for example, {example}) and reading it in the browser: that part is not sent to the tool's server or to its access log.
panelAppForm.sessionTipStorage: After verifying, store the session in a way that works inside the panel: in {storage}, in the address itself or in a cookie with {cookie}. A regular cookie usually does not work inside another site.
panelAppForm.sessionTipClean: Remove the token from the address after reading it (for example, with {fn}), so it does not stay in the browser history.
panelAppForm.sessionTipMasked: With {masked} true, the contact data is not sent: do not use an empty field as a search filter, or the tool would show the entire list.

help.label: How the test works
help.title: Test connection
help.what: Checks, from this browser, what the WebPhone will find: whether the server opens the connection, answers in SIP and accepts the user, password and domain. It uses the filled-in details, even before saving, and shows the fix for each problem.
help.alertNoCall: It does not place a call or test audio: an accepted registration does not guarantee that calls go through.
help.alertNoDisrupt: It does not register the extension, so it does not disconnect the phone or agent already using it.
help.alertPassword: The password is sent once per test. Several wrong passwords in a row can make the provider block this network for a few minutes, so there is a 30-second wait between tests.
help.alertServer: When the connection does not open, the system server repeats only the connection (without the password) to find out why.
help.alertNetwork: The result applies to this computer's network. If the agent is on another network, their result may differ.

configMissing.title: Missing details
configMissing.hint: Fill in the user, password and SIP server before testing.

serverHasScheme.title: The SIP server must contain only the address
serverHasScheme.hint: Remove "wss://", "sip:" or "https://" from the beginning. Example: sip.provider.com

serverHasPath.title: The SIP server must contain only the address
serverHasPath.hint: Remove the slash and everything after it. The WebPhone already uses the /ws path on its own.

serverHasPort.title: The port is inside the SIP server field
serverHasPort.hint: Leave only the address in SIP server and put {port} in the Port field.

serverInvalid.title: The SIP server is not a valid address
serverInvalid.hint: Use only the server name or IP, without spaces, @ or extension.

portInvalid.title: Invalid port
portInvalid.hint: Use a number from 1 to 65535. The provider gives the WebSocket port (common ones: 8089, 443, 7443, 8080).

domainInvalid.title: The SIP domain must contain only the domain
domainInvalid.hint: No "sip:", extension, @ or port. Example: pbx.provider.com or the IP given by the provider.

mixedContent.title: WS does not work in this panel
mixedContent.hint: The panel opens over HTTPS, and the browser blocks unencrypted connections. Use WSS with the provider's secure port.

uriInvalid.title: User or domain has an invalid character
uriInvalid.hint: Check that the user and domain are written exactly as the provider gave them.

udpNotSupported.title: Test unavailable for UDP
udpNotSupported.hint: The test works with WSS and WS.

checkUnavailable.title: The connection could not be opened
checkUnavailable.hint: Check the server and port with the provider. The browser also refuses servers with an invalid certificate.

browserOnly.title: The system server connects, but this browser does not
browserOnly.hint: The provider is online. The block is in this computer's network (firewall, antivirus, proxy) or in the certificate, which this browser does not accept. Open {scheme}://{host}:{port} in a tab to see the browser warning, or test from another network.

privateNetwork.title: The server is on an internal network
privateNetwork.hint: For security, the system server does not test internal addresses. Check that this computer can reach that network and that the server and port are correct.

ownMachine.title: The server given is the system's own machine
ownMachine.hint: For security, the system server does not test itself. If the PBX runs on this same machine, check the port and certificate with whoever manages the server.

accountBadChallenge.title: The server asked for the password in a way the WebPhone does not accept
accountBadChallenge.hint: The password request came without realm or nonce, or with an unknown protection type. Copy the details and send them to the provider.

dnsNotFound.title: The address {host} does not exist
dnsNotFound.hint: Check that the SIP server was typed correctly.

dnsFailed.title: Could not look up the address {host}
dnsFailed.hint: Try again in a moment. If it persists, check the address with the provider.

tcpRefused.title: Port {port} is closed on the server
tcpRefused.hint: Nothing answers on that port. Confirm the WebSocket (WSS) port with the provider.

tcpTimeout.title: Port {port} did not respond
tcpTimeout.hint: Usually a provider firewall or a wrong port. Confirm the port and ask for access to be allowed.

tcpUnreachable.title: The server could not be reached
tcpUnreachable.hint: The address exists, but the network does not reach it. Confirm the address with the provider.

tcpFailed.title: The connection to port {port} failed
tcpFailed.hint: Confirm the port with the provider and try again.

tlsNotTls.title: Port {port} does not use a secure connection
tlsNotTls.hint: It answers, but without a certificate (TLS). Confirm it is the WSS port: if the provider uses WS on that port, the HTTPS panel cannot use it.

tlsFailed.title: The secure connection failed
tlsFailed.hint: The server closed the connection during the certificate exchange. Confirm the WSS port with the provider.

tlsCertExpired.title: The server certificate expired on {validTo}
tlsCertExpired.hint: The browser refuses expired certificates. The provider needs to renew the certificate.

tlsCertNotYetValid.title: The server certificate is not valid yet
tlsCertNotYetValid.hint: The certificate date is in the future or the server clock is wrong. Tell the provider.

tlsCertSelfSigned.title: The server certificate is not from a recognized authority
tlsCertSelfSigned.hint: It is self-signed or from a private issuer, and the browser refuses it. The provider needs to install a valid certificate (for example, Let's Encrypt) for {host}.

tlsCertHostname.title: The certificate is not for the address {host}
tlsCertHostname.hint: It was issued for {subject}. Use the certificate address in SIP server or ask the provider for a certificate for {host}.

tlsCertUntrusted.title: The server certificate is not recognized
tlsCertUntrusted.hint: Unrecognized issuer or incomplete chain (missing intermediate certificate). The provider needs to fix the certificate.

wsHttp404.title: The server has no WebSocket on the /ws path
wsHttp404.hint: The WebPhone always connects to /ws. Confirm with the provider the WebSocket port and whether it answers on /ws.

wsHttp400.title: The server refused the connection request (400)
wsHttp400.hint: This is usually an origin or SIP protocol requirement. Ask the provider to allow WebRTC connections coming from {origin}.

wsHttp403.title: The server refused the panel origin
wsHttp403.hint: Ask the provider to allow {origin} in the WebSocket allowed origins.

wsHttpRedirect.title: The server redirected the connection ({status})
wsHttpRedirect.hint: WebSocket does not follow redirects. Use the final address given by the provider.

wsHttpOther.title: The server answered {status} instead of opening the WebSocket
wsHttpOther.hint: This port looks like a website, not the SIP WebSocket. Confirm the port with the provider.

wsNoSubprotocol.title: The WebSocket opened, but without the SIP protocol
wsNoSubprotocol.hint: The browser requires the "sip" protocol on the WebSocket. Confirm with the provider that this is the SIP WebSocket port.

wsBadAccept.title: The server answered the WebSocket in an invalid way
wsBadAccept.hint: A proxy in the way may be changing the response. Tell the provider.

wsIsSipTcp.title: Port {port} speaks SIP directly, without WebSocket
wsIsSipTcp.hint: It is a regular SIP port (TCP). The WebPhone needs the provider's WebSocket (WSS) port.

wsNoResponse.title: The server did not answer the WebSocket request
wsNoResponse.hint: Confirm the WebSocket port with the provider.

wsBadResponse.title: Port {port} did not answer as a WebSocket
wsBadResponse.hint: Confirm the WebSocket port with the provider.

rateLimited.title: Too many tests in a row
rateLimited.hint: Wait a minute and try again.

sipChecking.title: Checking whether the server answers in SIP...

sipNoResponse.title: The connection opened, but the server did not answer in SIP
sipNoResponse.hint: Confirm that this is the provider's SIP WebSocket port.

sipClosed.title: The server closed the connection during the test
sipClosed.hint: It may be a provider block. Wait a few minutes and try again; if it persists, tell the provider.

accountOk.title: User, password and domain accepted
accountOk.hint: {bindings, plural, =0 {No device registered on this extension right now.} one {# device registered on this extension right now.} other {# devices registered on this extension right now.}}

accountOkNoAuth.title: The server accepted the extension without asking for a password
accountOkNoAuth.hint: The connection works. If the provider should ask for a password, check with them.

accountWrongPassword.title: User or password refused
accountWrongPassword.hint: Check the extension user and password with the provider. Several wrong passwords in a row can block this network at the provider for a few minutes.

accountForbidden.title: The server refused the extension (403)
accountForbidden.hint: Wrong password, disabled extension or extension not allowed to connect from the browser. Check with the provider.

accountNotFound.title: The server does not recognize the domain {domain}
accountNotFound.hint: It did not find the extension {user} in that domain. Ask the provider for the exact extension domain and put it in SIP domain (sometimes it is the PBX IP).

accountNotFoundAfterAuth.title: The password was accepted, but extension {user} was not found
accountNotFoundAfterAuth.hint: Check the user with the provider: sometimes the extension is just the number, without a prefix.

accountLoop.title: The server looped with the domain {domain} (483)
accountLoop.hint: The connection server does not know where to send this domain and sends it to itself. Fill in SIP domain with the PBX domain given by the provider (sometimes it is the PBX IP).

accountTimeout.title: The server did not answer the registration
accountTimeout.hint: The connection server may not be reaching the PBX. Tell the provider.

accountServerError.title: The server answered with an error ({status})
accountServerError.hint: A problem on the provider side. Try again later or tell the provider.

accountMethodNotAllowed.title: The server does not accept extension registration ({status})
accountMethodNotAllowed.hint: This address seems to be for calls or trunks only. Confirm with the provider the server for WebRTC extensions.

accountAlgorithmUnsupported.title: The server asks for the password with the {algorithm} method
accountAlgorithmUnsupported.hint: The WebPhone only uses the MD5 method. Ask the provider to accept MD5 for this extension.

accountQueryUnsupported.title: Domain accepted, but the password could not be checked
accountQueryUnsupported.hint: This server only checks the password in a real registration, and the test does not register so it does not disconnect whoever is using the extension. The password will be checked when the WebPhone connects.

accountBadRequest.title: The server refused the extension test ({status})
accountBadRequest.hint: Neither the domain nor the password could be checked. Copy the details and send them to the provider.

accountOther.title: The server answered {status} {reason}
accountOther.hint: Copy the details and send them to the provider.

domainHintFound.title: The server accepts the domain {domain}
domainHintFound.hint: It is the IP of {from}. Use {domain} in SIP domain, test again and save the user.

domainHintNone.title: The IP {domain} was not accepted either
domainHintNone.hint: Ask the provider for the exact extension domain.

sessoesPage.imapPassUsesSmtpTip: When left blank, receiving uses the same password as sending (SMTP).
sessoesPage.emailSecretMaskedTip: The saved value is only shown to administrators. Leave the field as it is to keep the current value, or type a new one.
sessoesPage.uazapiStatusCheckTip: The channel status is checked every 10 minutes. If UAzapi answers that the instance is disconnected, that the token is invalid or that the instance does not exist, the channel is marked as disconnected right away. If it spends more than 30 minutes saying the instance is connecting or paused, or refusing access, the channel is revalidated and, if it does not come back, marked as disconnected. Messages that arrive while it is disconnected are not received. If the instance answers as connected again within 24 hours, the channel reconnects on its own.
sessoesPage.emailAutomationsTip: Queue greeting, flow, away message and campaign reply triggers apply to emails received by IMAP, POP3 and Gmail from the moment the account is connected. In Gmail, up to 10 emails already in the mailbox are added to the history without an automatic reply, and an email that cannot be saved stays unread and is retried, up to 3 times per hour, while it is among the 10 most recent in the mailbox.
sessoesPage.emailPasswordRequired: When you change the email server, type the sending and receiving passwords again.
sessoesPage.emailPasswordMaskedTip: The saved password is only shown to administrators. Leave the field as it is to keep the current password, or type a new one. When you change the email server, type the password again.
sessoesPage.helpS0I3: In the ChatGPT section you choose between your own key and the platform AI, which spends from AI Credits.

aiAgentSection.tooltip: With a linked agent, every new conversation on this channel is handled by it first.

sessoesPage.hybridRiskWarning: Hybrid mode uses an unofficial API connection, which is not guaranteed by Meta: it is subject to instability (connection drops) and to the risk of the number being blocked. In coexistence this risk falls on the same official number. Enable it consciously.
sessoesPage.hybridModeHint: Disabled: everything via the official API. Two numbers: active conversations move to another channel. Coexistence: the same number sends session messages via the linked channel.
sessoesPage.hybridLinkedCoexNote: In coexistence, the linked channel must be a non-official channel (Baileys, WhatsApp Web, Meow, Evolution, Z-API or UAZAPI) connected via QR code to the same number.
sessoesPage.hybridNativeInteractiveLabel: Buttons and lists via the official API
sessoesPage.hybridNativeInteractiveHint: Off: in coexistence, buttons and lists become a numbered text menu sent through the linked connection, free of charge. On: they are delivered as real buttons and lists via the official API, within the conversation's 24-hour window.
sessoesPage.wabaGroupBotHint: Flow, Typebot and automatic closing send consecutive texts as a single message.
sessoesPage.wabaGroupBotTip: The official API charges for every message sent. When on, consecutive texts from the same flow block, the same Typebot reply and the automatic closing go out as a single message, and the text right before buttons or a list goes in the menu body. The automatic closing farewell goes together with the satisfaction survey. Note: the customer sees one block of text instead of several bubbles; the flow's Delay block still splits messages; media is sent separately; each message has at most 4,096 characters; outgoing webhooks receive the combined message; the change may take up to 1 minute to apply.
sessoesPage.wabaGroupAgentHint: 0 turns it off. From 2 to 15 seconds.
sessoesPage.wabaGroupAgentTip: After each agent text, the screen waits the chosen number of seconds; if another text comes in during that time, both go out as a single message. If the agent sends a file right after, the text becomes its caption. Note: the message only goes out after the wait (at most 30 seconds in total); first response time counts when it goes out; it does not wait on channels in hybrid mode or near the end of the 24-hour window; a customer message, switching tickets or leaving the screen sends the text right away; force-closing the browser during the wait may lose that text.
sessoesPage.wabaGroupAgentInvalid: Use 0 to turn it off or a value from 2 to 15.
sessoesPage.mlEventsHint: Off: only post-sale messages and listing questions arrive. On: the buyer's claim lands in their conversation and order changes become a note in the open ticket.
sessoesPage.mlEventsNote: You also need to enable the claims and orders topics in the Mercado Libre developer panel — without that, nothing is sent here. A claim never goes through chatbot or AI: it goes straight to the queue.
sessoesPage.igCommentsHint: Turn off to receive only direct messages on this channel.
sessoesPage.igCommentsTooltip: On: every comment on a post or reel goes into the contact's ticket, like a message. Off: comments don't show up in the ticket and don't open a ticket; direct messages keep working as usual. Comment automations keep working: the public reply is posted and, if the automation sends a direct message or hands off to a flow, the ticket is opened at that moment, already containing the sent message. Comments on lives never open a ticket.

sessoesPage.ignoreBusinessHoursTooltip:
How business hours are applied to this connection:
- Follow company hours: uses the company hours (and the queue, if any).
- Ignore hours: open 24/7.
- Queue hours only: ignores the company hours and holidays; follows only the hours set on the queue this connection routes to (no queue hours = open 24/7).
sessoesPage.ignoreBusinessHoursModeDisabledDesc: Uses the business hours set on the company (and the queue, when present). Default behavior.
sessoesPage.ignoreBusinessHoursModeEnabledDesc: The connection is open 24/7: ignores both company and queue hours.
sessoesPage.ignoreBusinessHoursModeQueueOnlyDesc: Ignores the company hours and holidays; service is controlled only by the queue hours. With no queue hours, open 24/7.
sessoesPage.autoReassignDesc: Automatically redistributes tickets from users who have been offline longer than the configured time.
sessoesPage.autoReassignMethodRandomDesc: Assigns the ticket to a random available agent.
sessoesPage.autoReassignMethodBalancedDesc: Assigns to the agent with the fewest open tickets today.
sessoesPage.autoReassignMethodSequentialDesc: Assigns in round-robin rotation among queue agents.
sessoesPage.enableAutoShutdown: Enable automatic shutdown of external integrations
sessoesPage.enableAutoShutdownDesc: When a ticket is opened, integrations (ChatGPT, Typebot, Dify, N8N, DialogFlow) will be automatically turned off.
sessoesPage.enableProcessingWait: Enable wait in processing with external integrations
sessoesPage.enableProcessingWaitDesc: The system only processes new messages after the first one has been answered by the integration (Typebot, ChatGPT…).
sessoesPage.enableWebPushDesc: The system will send push notifications to the app.
sessoesPage.contingencyDesc: If active: the channel receives messages. If inactive: remains connected but does not receive messages.
sessoesPage.contingencyDescMeta: If inactive: the channel stops sending messages (pending, scheduled and campaign messages stay on hold). Incoming messages keep arriving normally.
sessoesPage.inactiveTooltipAuto: Automatically disabled by the system on {date}, after repeated connection failures. While it stays this way the channel does not send messages: pending, scheduled and campaign messages stay on hold. Fix the settings and click Connect — the channel is reactivated on connection.
sessoesPage.inactiveTooltipManual: Contingency turned off in the channel settings. The channel is paused and does not send messages. To reactivate it, open Edit and turn Contingency on.
sessoesPage.closeKeywordDesc: When this keyword is received, the ticket will be automatically closed.
sessoesPage.importAttentionDesc: Import may take a long time. Do not close the browser during the process. After connecting via QR Code, import will start automatically.
sessoesPage.inactivitySectionHint: Choose what happens when the customer stops replying for a while. If you don't set it here, the system's general rule applies.
sessoesPage.inactivityModeOff: Don't close by inactivity on this channel

sessoesPage.inactivityOfficialWindowNote: On this official channel, if the contact's last message is more than 24 hours old, inactivity closing does not send the message, file or rating set here: Meta would refuse sending outside the 24-hour window.
sessoesPage.inactivityTimeLabel: Close after (minutes without a customer reply)

sessoesPage.queuePositionTooltip:
When a new ticket enters the queue as pending, the system sends an automatic message informing the customer of their position and the average waiting time.

Inherit: follows the tenant's global setting.
Enabled: overrides the global and uses this channel's setting.
Disabled: overrides the global and does not send.

The trigger fires only once per ticket, after the chatbot/flow finishes. If the ticket is auto-assigned to an agent or a chatbot takes over, the message is not sent.

Position scope: counted within the ticket's queue; if no queue, counted by channel. Supported channels: WhatsApp Web, Baileys, WABA, Instagram, Messenger, Webchat, Telegram, Evolution, Z-API, UazAPI, Meow, Hub.

sessoesPage.baileysAuthStoreDesc: SQLite stores the session crypto keys in a single auth.db file, avoiding the buildup of thousands of JSON files. Switching migrates the current state without a new QR.

sessoesPage.baileysAuthStoreHelp: Files stores the WhatsApp session keys in many files on the server; SQLite keeps everything in a single file (auth.db). The switch happens on the next connection, with no new QR code. Note: right after the switch, some group messages may take a while to appear while WhatsApp rebuilds each group's keys, and the first message sent to each group takes a little longer. With SQLite the keys are stored on the server without the encryption used by Files: protect access to the server and to backups.

sessoesPage.baileysAuthStoreSqliteUnavailableActive: This channel is set to SQLite, but the server is missing the required component, so it is running on Files. Nothing is lost: once the system is updated with the component, the channel switches to SQLite on its own the next time it starts, with no new QR code. That first start may take a little longer.

metaPage.sentCostHint: Estimate based on what left the channel through the platform, using Meta's rules: service messages (replies inside the conversation) were free until 09/30/2026; since 10/01/2026 the first 1,000 of the month, per phone number, are free and the rest pay the rate (R$ 0.035 in Brazil). Templates are always charged and never count toward the free tier (marketing costs more: adjust the rate to simulate); before 10/01/2026, utility templates sent while the conversation was open were free, and they show as charged here. Internal notes and dividers are excluded. The amount actually charged, with Meta's own data, is under Usage & Limits › Billing.

The free tier does not roll over and restarts every month.
metaPage.sentCostLegacyNote: The server does not separate Meta's free tier yet: for now, this estimate counts every message as charged. After the server is updated, it will subtract the 1,000 free messages per phone number.

customProfiles.title: Access Profiles

help.description: Create reusable permission templates. Each profile can be assigned to many users with profile=custom.

s0.title: How it works
s0.i0: Create a profile with a descriptive name (ex: Night Agent).
s0.i1: Pick sidebar-visible modules and action permissions (buttons, exports, etc.).
s0.i2: Then in Users, pick profile=custom and select this profile.

s1.title: Use AI
s1.i0: Describe what the user needs to do in plain language.
s1.i1: Copilot will suggest permissions in seconds.
s1.i2: Always review the toggles before saving — defaults are safe.

s2.title: Important rules
s2.i0: A profile used by 1+ user cannot be deleted. Reassign first.
s2.i1: Profile changes propagate in realtime to all linked users via socket.

tenantsPage.maxConnectionsHelp: Maximum number of connections (channels) the client can create.
tenantsPage.trialEnabledHelp: With the trial on, the company is deactivated automatically as soon as the period ends and no one can sign in until it is reactivated.
tenantsPage.trialDurationHelp: Trial days counted from the company's creation date. Minimum of 1 day. The user menu shows the days left and the end date.
tenantsPage.trialDurationNote: Counted from the company's creation date. If billing is already set up, access runs until the first invoice instead of ending when this period is over.
tenantsPage.errorTrialDurationRequired: Enter the trial duration in days (minimum 1).
tenantsPage.hidePaymentsFromUsersDesc: When enabled, only admin/superadmin can see this tenant's subscription, invoices and billing alerts. Recommended for data privacy compliance.
tenantsPage.enablePlatformGoogleAppDesc: When enabled, users of this tenant can choose "Use platform Google app" when connecting Gmail, Google Calendar or YouTube. When disabled, only the own-app option is available.
tenantsPage.wavoipEnabledDesc: Turns on WaVoIP voice calling for this company: token field on the channels, call button in tickets, bulk dialer and the calls page. When off, all of it disappears and calls are blocked on the API too.
tenantsPage.wavoipEnabledNote: Tokens already saved on the channels are kept — just turn it back on and everything returns. Note: turning it off here does not unlink the number at WaVoIP. Calls keep arriving there with nobody to answer, and the device stays billed. To stop for good, remove the device in the WaVoIP panel.
tenantsPage.billingAlertMessagePlaceholder: e.g. Your payment is due soon...
tenantsPage.billingFlowTitle: How plans, billing and blocking work
tenantsPage.billingFlowI0: Plans define price, connections, users and trial. At signup the customer picks a plan and the gateway creates the charge.
tenantsPage.billingFlowI1: First charge due date: the initial invoice falls due in the configured number of days. Boleto/PIX are post-paid (no instant capture); instant charge requires a card.
tenantsPage.billingFlowI2: Require payment before access: when on, the tenant starts blocked and is released only once the gateway confirms the 1st payment.
tenantsPage.billingFlowI3: Overdue alert and block are set per tenant: warns N days before the due date and blocks N days after (0 = never blocks).
tenantsPage.firstChargeGlobalDesc: Global public-signup setting — affects all tenants, not just this one.
tenantsPage.firstChargeDueDaysHelp: Days until the first charge is due, at signup and on plan change. 0 = due today.
tenantsPage.requirePaymentBeforeAccessHelp: When on, new signups can only access the system after the 1st payment is confirmed.
tenantsPage.billingHelpAlert: Alert (days before): shows the customer a warning this many days before the invoice due date.
tenantsPage.billingHelpBlock: Tolerance (days after): blocks access (402 error) this many days after the due date if the invoice is not paid. Use 0 to never block (only flags as overdue).
tenantsPage.billingHelpLifecycle: Tenants with a gateway are governed by billing: there is no block at the end of the trial. Access lasts until the first charge and is only interrupted if the invoice goes unpaid past the tolerance.
tenantsPage.planDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Intermediate Plan — up to 15 users
tenantsPage.userPasswordModeDesc: Mirrors the tenant option in General Settings: manual, forced change on first login, or email invite.
tenantsPage.menuVisibilityPlanNote: Locked items are not included in this tenant's plan. Adjust the features in Plans.
tenantsPage.betaChannelTooltip: This channel is in beta. Some features may still be under development.
tenantsPage.errorFillMaxFields: Fill in maximum users and connections
tenantsPage.errorAsaasRequired: Asaas Token and Customer ID are required when Asaas is enabled
tenantsPage.deleteProtected: The main company (ID 1) cannot be deleted.
tenantsPage.confirmDeleteTenant: Do you really want to delete company {id}?
tenantsPage.deleteTenantNote: Deletes everything from this company and cannot be undone. Anything that arrives during the deletion is deleted too. A ticket, contact or bulk send from another company that uses a queue, tag or channel of this one keeps existing and only loses that link.
tenantsPage.tenantDeleteErrBlocked: A record linked to this company blocked the deletion. None of this company's data was deleted. Try again; if it repeats, the server log shows the step and the table.
tenantsPage.tenantDeleteErrTimeout: The deletion took too long in the database and was cancelled. None of this company's data was deleted. Try again at a quieter time.
tenantsPage.tenantDeleteErrConnection: The database became unavailable during the deletion. None of this company's data was deleted. Try again.
tenantsPage.tenantDeleteErrLock: The database was busy with this company's data. None of this company's data was deleted. Try again in a moment.
tenantsPage.tenantDeleteErrInProgress: This company is already being deleted. Wait for it to finish and refresh the list.
tenantsPage.tenantDeleteErrNotFound: This company no longer exists. Refresh the list.
tenantsPage.tenantDeleteErrFailed: The company could not be deleted. None of this company's data was deleted. The server log shows the step that failed.
tenantsPage.tenantDeleteErrStillRunning: The server response did not arrive, but the deletion may still be running. Refresh the list in a few minutes to check.
tenantsPage.confirmDeleteFiles: Do you really want to delete all files from company {id}?
tenantsPage.oauthGoogleDesc: OAuth Google settings for this tenant.
tenantsPage.oauthProxyUrlHint: Overrides the NEXT_PUBLIC_OAUTH_PROXY_URL environment variable for this tenant.
tenantsPage.igProxyUrlHint: URL of the central proxy that receives Instagram webhooks (Path B — accounts without a Facebook Page).
tenantsPage.igProxySecretHint: Must match REGISTRY_SECRET in the oauth-proxy .env.
tenantsPage.msgrProxyUrlHint: Central proxy URL that receives Messenger webhooks and routes by Page ID.
tenantsPage.msgrProxySecretHint: Must match REGISTRY_SECRET in the oauth-proxy .env.
tenantsPage.videoConferenceProviderGoogleMeetHint: Requires Google Calendar configured and active for this tenant.
tenantsPage.channelLimitsHint: Maximum connections per channel type. Use 0 for no limit.
tenantsPage.channelLimitsCanonicalNote: Official WhatsApp adds up channels connected manually and via Facebook login. Official Instagram and Official Facebook count the channels connected via login. Hub counts all Hub channels.
tenantsPage.cleanByFilterDesc: Deletes files from this company matching the filters below. Protected folders (birthday, chatbot, fastreply, galery, profile-pictures, tenant[id]) are not affected.
tenantsPage.cleanByFilterResult: Done: {count} file(s) deleted — {size} MB freed, {skipped} skipped.
tenantsPage.cleanByFilterErrors: {errors} file(s) could not be deleted — check the server logs.
tenantsPage.cleanByFilterNoFilter: Set at least one filter greater than zero.
tenantsPage.externalStorageNoticeAction: Notice: external storage (S3) is not affected by this operation. Files on the external provider must be managed directly there.
tenantsPage.externalStorageNoticeSize: Notice: this calculation only covers local storage. Files on external storage (S3) are not counted — check directly on the provider.

tenantsPage.proxySharedChannelsNotice: The credentials below (URL + secret) are shared by every channel that uses the proxy: Instagram, Messenger, WABA, WooCommerce, Mercado Livre, OLX, LinkedIn and TikTok. Setting them here enables robust routing for all of them.

locationShare.pastePlaceholder: Google Maps or Waze link, or -23.5505, -46.6333
locationShare.pasteHelp: Accepts Google Maps, Waze, Apple Maps and OpenStreetMap links, or the coordinates (including in degrees). For the short link from the Share button, open it in the browser and paste the full link from the address bar.
locationShare.notRecognized: No location found in this text. Paste a map link or the coordinates.
locationShare.shortLinkHelp: This short link doesn't include the coordinates. Open it in the browser and paste the full link from the address bar, or paste the coordinates.
locationShare.savedLocationsHelp: Locations registered in Quick Messages with the Location type. Click to fill in.
locationShare.saveAsQuickReplyHelp: Creates a quick message of the Location type. Then just type / and the shortcut in the ticket.
locationShare.shortcutRequired: Enter the shortcut to save the location.
locationShare.shortcutExists: A quick message with this shortcut already exists.
locationShare.forWholeTeamHelp: If unchecked, only you see this saved location.
locationShare.saveFailed: The location was sent, but it could not be saved.
locationShare.forwardNote: The location is sent as text with the Google Maps and Waze links.
locationShare.quickReplyTypeNote: On channels that support it, it is sent as a map location (in the ticket, the window opens already filled in). On the others, it is sent as text with the Google Maps and Waze links.
locationShare.quickReplyUnreadable: Could not read this saved location. Fill it in again.
locationShare.flowErrInvalid: Fix the latitude and longitude of the Location interaction in node {node} before saving.
locationShare.flowNodeNote: On WhatsApp and WebChat, it is sent as a map location. On Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and Hub, it is sent as text with the Google Maps and Waze links. Name and address accept flow variables. If sending fails, the flow moves on to the next interaction.

messageBubble.webchatInviteLinkWarning: Only the customer should open it: whoever opens it first keeps the conversation.
messageBubble.adReferralHelp: Meta tells which ad or link the contact came from when they send the message. The image comes from Meta itself and stops showing after a few days; the title and ID remain. To find the ad, paste the ID into the Ads Manager search.

formSubmission.title: Form received · {name}
formSubmission.help: Answers the contact sent through the form. Only your team sees this card: it is not sent to the contact, so you can't quote, forward or react to it. To talk to the contact, write in the conversation as usual.

messageBubble.igStoryReplyHint: Message sent as a reply to an Instagram story. "View story" opens the story through the Instagram link, which only works while the story is live (usually up to 24 hours).
messageBubble.igStoryReplyHintBot: When the customer replies with text, that text is what the chatbot, the AI and the automations receive.
messageBubble.ackErrorMIGRATION_NOT_SENT: This message was pending on the previous server and was not sent after the migration, so the customer would not receive it twice. Send it again if it is still needed.
messageBubble.ackErrorLOCATION_SEND_FAILED: The flow location was not sent (connection offline or sending refused). The flow moved on to the next interaction.
messageBubble.ackErrorCHANNEL_DISCONNECTED: The channel was disconnected and the message was not sent. Reconnect the channel and send it again.
messageBubble.ackErrorINSTAGRAM_DOCUMENT_NOT_PDF: Instagram only accepts PDF documents, so this file was not sent. Send the file as a PDF.
messageBubble.ackErrorINSTAGRAM_STICKER_NOT_SUPPORTED: Instagram does not accept stickers, so this sticker was not sent.
messageBubble.hybridFallbackTooltip: Sent via the official channel — hybrid mode fallback (transport failed).
messageBubble.hybridRoutedTooltip: Message routed by hybrid mode: sent through the linked connection.
messageBubble.metaUnsupportedType: Meta does not support this message type.
messageBubble.metaMessageUnavailable: Message unavailable: WhatsApp did not deliver the content. Ask the customer to send it again.
messageBubble.ackError131026: Message undeliverable: recipient unavailable or not on WhatsApp
messageBubble.ackError131042: Payment failure on the Meta account. Check the payment method in WhatsApp Manager.
messageBubble.ackError131047: 24-hour window expired — send a template to reopen the conversation
messageBubble.ackError131049: Meta limited marketing messages to this recipient
messageBubble.ackError100_33: Meta could not find the number configured in this channel, or access to it was lost. An administrator should check the channel's Phone Number ID in Sessions (it is the number's ID, not the WABA account's) and the token, or reconnect the channel.
messageBubble.ackError133010: This number is not activated on Meta for sending. An administrator should review the channel in Sessions: for official WhatsApp connected directly, use Register PIN in the channel menu; for a WhatsApp Business app number or a partner channel, reconnect the channel.
messageBubble.ackErrorNO_SEND_CONTEXT: This ticket has no active conversation on the channel to receive the message. Wait for the customer to reach out again and try once more.
messageBubble.ackErrorTELEGRAM_UNREACHABLE: The contact blocked the bot, deleted their Telegram account or never talked to this bot. On Telegram, a bot can only message people who have messaged it first.
messageBubble.ackErrorTELEGRAM_MEDIA_MISSING: The media file was not found on the server. Send the media again.
messageBubble.locationRequestDescription: The contact requested to share your location
messageBubble.externalLinkBody: This link points to an external site. Do you want to continue?
messageBubble.linkModalHint: If the content doesn't appear, open in a new tab.
messageBubble.transferHintInternal: Internal ticket record: only the team sees it, and it is never sent to the contact.
messageBubble.transferHintManual: Made by a team member: it does not count as a reply to the customer, and the inactivity closing countdown restarts from here.
messageBubble.transferHintApi: Made by an integration through the API: it does not count as a reply to the customer, and the inactivity closing countdown restarts from here.
messageBubble.transferHintOffline: Made by the system because the agent was offline. It does not count as a reply to the customer or change the inactivity closing countdown.
messageBubble.transferHintDistribution: Made by the queue's automatic distribution. It does not count as a reply to the customer or change the inactivity closing countdown.
messageBubble.transferHintInactivity: Made by the inactivity closing, which sent the ticket to the chatbot. It does not count as a reply to the customer.
messageBubble.transferHintUserDeleted: Made by the system because the agent was deleted. It does not count as a reply to the customer or change the inactivity closing countdown.
messageBubble.aiSystemPrompt: You are an intelligent assistant. Analyze the message below and provide a clear and useful analysis about the content, intent, and context of the message.
messageBubble.searchOnGoogleTip: Image copied! Opening Google Lens shortly... Paste with Ctrl+V to search.
messageBubble.vcardSelectSessionDesc: Choose the channel to start a conversation with {name}
messageBubble.vcardExistingMessage: There is already a ticket with this contact. Do you want to open it?
messageBubble.mediaDownloadLimitedDesc: This file could not be downloaded: the channel server did not respond in time, refused the download, or the file exceeded the maximum size. Check it on the device or ask the contact to send it again.
messageBubble.groupingHint: This text waits a few seconds to go out together with the next ones, as a single message. First response time counts when it goes out.

smsConfigPage.title: SMS
smsConfigPage.helpDesc: Configure SMS provider credentials for sending text messages.

smsConfigPage.helpS1I2: Use SMS to send important confirmations and notifications to customers.
smsConfigPage.comteleRouteNote: Shown for keys created in the new Comtele panel, which requires a route for every message. Each route has its own price and delivery priority; on automatic, the system uses the cheapest one.

zapiPage.title: Z-API
zapiPage.helpDesc: Configure the Z-API integration to connect WhatsApp channels via QR Code.
zapiPage.helpS0I0: Open the Z-API dashboard and copy the API base URL
zapiPage.helpS0I1: Copy the Global Key from your Z-API plan and paste it into the corresponding field
zapiPage.helpS1I0: After saving the settings, go to Channels to add a new Z-API instance

globalProviderNotice.title: Global provider active
globalProviderNotice.message: The system administrator has set up a global provider for this integration. While it is active, the global configuration takes priority and the fields filled in on this page may be ignored.

uazapiPage.title: UazAPI

uazapiPage.helpS0I2: Save and create instances on the Sessions page to connect WhatsApp.
uazapiPage.helpS1I2: Restart the instance in the UazAPI dashboard if the connection drops.

proxyPage.title: Proxy

proxyPage.helpS0I0: Enter the proxy host, port and type (HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5).

webchatLinks.title: WebChat
webchatLinks.count: {count, plural, one {# browser linked} other {# browsers linked}}
webchatLinks.confirmText: The browsers linked to this contact stop receiving the conversation, and the invite links already sent stop working. To bring the customer back, send a new link.
webchatLinks.error: Could not unlink the WebChat browsers
webchatLinks.tooltip: Browsers that opened the WebChat invite link and chat as this contact.

webchatPage.inviteLinkDescription: A customer who opens the link sent over WhatsApp continues the conversation here as the same contact.
webchatPage.inviteLinkTooltip: Put the link variable in a flow message or a quick reply. The customer taps the link and continues the conversation in this WebChat as the same contact: history, tags and phone search stay together. Only one WebChat channel per company accepts invites: turning it on here turns it off in the others.
webchatPage.inviteLinkVariableHint: Use the {variable} variable in the flow or in a quick reply.
webchatPage.inviteMessageHint: Message sent by the Send WebChat invite button in official WhatsApp tickets. Use {variable} where the link should go; without it, the link goes at the end. Leave it blank to use the default text shown in the field, in the company's language.
webchatPage.inviteMessageSaveError: Could not save the invite text

inviteSend.tooltip: Sends the customer a link to continue this conversation on WebChat as the same contact. Only the invite message is charged by official WhatsApp.
inviteSend.windowClosed: 24-hour window closed: WhatsApp only accepts an approved template. The invite becomes available again when the customer writes back.
inviteSend.title: Send WebChat invite
inviteSend.description: The customer receives the message below with a link to continue the conversation on WebChat as the same contact.
inviteSend.unavailable: The invite is not available right now. Check in Settings > Webchat that a channel has Accept the invite link turned on.
inviteSend.textSource: The text comes from Settings > Webchat, in the company's language. The link is created when sending.
inviteSend.alertCost: This message is charged like any other official WhatsApp message. What the customer says on WebChat is not.
inviteSend.alertSingleUse: The link is valid for 24 hours and only for the first browser that opens it.
inviteSend.alertTicketOpen: This ticket stays open: close it once the customer moves to WebChat.
inviteSend.alertNoNotify: WebChat does not notify the customer when the page is closed. A reply sent after they leave is only seen if they return to the link.
inviteSend.sendRefused: Invite not sent: the link is not available right now. Check Settings > Webchat and try again.

webchatPage.inviteLinkSaveError: Could not save the invite link
webchatPage.inviteLinkAlertOnce: The link is valid for 24 hours and works only once: the first browser that opens it keeps the conversation. Do not open the customer's link.
webchatPage.inviteLinkAlertCloseFlow: End the WhatsApp flow by closing the ticket after the link. Otherwise the inactivity message keeps going out over WhatsApp.
webchatPage.inviteLinkAlertAudience: A flow with the New customers only audience may not run for someone who arrives by the link, because they already have the WhatsApp ticket. A portfolio that skips the flow also skips the WebChat one.
webchatPage.inviteLinkAlertDispatch: While the WebChat ticket is open, the customer is left out of dispatches that check for an active conversation. Use automatic closing on the WebChat channel.
webchatPage.inviteLinkAlertEmpty: The link comes out empty when no channel is selected, in groups, in email, in the WebChat itself and in scheduled messages.
webchatPage.inviteLinkAlertAlone: Do not leave the variable alone in the message: write some text with it. In New Conversation the link does not work, because there is no ticket yet.
webchatPage.inviteLinkAlertInApp: If the customer opens the link inside Instagram, Messenger or Telegram, the conversation is kept only in that app's browser.
webchatPage.inviteLinkAlertUnlink: To undo it, use Unlink WebChat browsers on the contact record. Links already sent stop working.
webchatPage.embedOptionDesc: Best for your own website: paste the code into the HTML and the chat bubble appears in the corner of the page.
webchatPage.directLinkOptionDesc: Best for apps, QR Codes, pop-ups and portals where you cannot paste code: a ready-to-use chat page opened by a link.
webchatPage.directLinkToggleDesc: Publishes a public chat page for this channel. When off, the link does not work.
webchatPage.directLinkQrHint: Point the phone camera to open the conversation.
webchatPage.directLinkHelpTitle: How to use the direct link
webchatPage.directLinkHelpParams: Optional URL parameters: ?nome=&telefone=&email=&origem= — they pre-fill the contact data on the first message.
webchatPage.directLinkHelpExamples: Examples: open inside the app (WebView), a customer service button in the app, a printed QR Code, a chat window in portals.
webchatPage.directLinkHelpDevice: The conversation is kept per device: closing and reopening keeps the history. Continuity across different devices will come with signed identification.
webchatPage.directLinkHelpWebview: In Android apps, attachments and audio require the app to allow file selection and microphone use; on iOS it works natively.
webchatPage.directLinkHelpUnread: The page notifies the host app about unread messages (event 'zchat:unread'), so the app can show a native badge.
webchatPage.directLinkDisabledHint: Enable the direct link to generate the URL and the QR Code.
webchatPage.appearanceDesc: Customizes only the direct link page — the embed code keeps the default look.
webchatPage.appearanceTitlePlaceholder: Name shown at the top of the conversation
webchatPage.appearanceWelcomeDesc: First bubble shown when the page opens (does not create a message in the ticket).
webchatPage.preChatDesc: Asks the visitor for details before starting the conversation.
webchatPage.preChatDirectLinkOnlyDesc: The form is shown only to visitors who open the conversation through the direct link (public URL or QR Code) in the browser. The widget installed on the website does not show the form. To use it, keep the direct link enabled.
webchatPage.preChatPrivacyTextDesc: When filled in, shows an acceptance checkbox before starting the conversation.
webchatPage.pageTextsDesc: Overrides the default texts of the public page — useful to serve another language. Empty = default.
webchatPage.previewHint: The preview opens this channel's own public page.
webchatPage.previewUnavailable: Enable the direct link and save to preview.
webchatPage.previewDraftHint: Shows your changes instantly, before saving. Visitors only see them after you save.
webchatPage.title: Webchat
webchatPage.description: Chat widget settings for your website
webchatPage.statusWssGenerate: Select a channel and generate the widget to embed on your site.
webchatPage.statusWssDown: The WSS URL is not responding.
webchatPage.statusWssDownHint: Check that the WSS server is active and reachable.
webchatPage.statusNotConfiguredHint: Request installation and configure the environment correctly.

webchatPage.helpDesc: Configure and generate the Webchat widget to add live chat to your website.
webchatPage.helpS0I0: Select the configured Webchat channel from the list
webchatPage.helpS0I1: Click Generate Widget to get the embed code
webchatPage.helpS1I0: The authentication token ensures that only your website sends messages
webchatPage.helpS1I1: Generate a new token if the current one is compromised — existing widgets will stop working.
webchatPage.helpS2I0: Adjust the widget colors and texts to match your site's visual identity
webchatPage.helpS2I1: Configure availability hours to display the widget only at defined times
webchatPage.helpS0I2: Paste the generated code into your website's HTML before the closing tag '</body>'
webchatPage.helpS1I2: Install a Webchat channel in Sessions before generating the widget.
webchatPage.migrationDesc: The Webchat WebSocket now runs on the same port as the backend, eliminating the need for separate WSS_PORT and WSS_URL. New widgets already use this configuration automatically.
webchatPage.migrationBothActive: Both modes are active. Old widgets (WSS_URL) and new widgets (BACKEND_URL) work simultaneously. You can remove WSS_PORT and WSS_URL from .env once all widgets are regenerated.
webchatPage.migrationLegacyOnly: Only legacy mode (WSS_URL) is active. The WebSocket on the main port is not responding. Check if the backend has been updated to support the new mode.
webchatPage.widgetRequiresConnection: Connect the channel before generating the widget
webchatPage.enableMenuButtonsDesc: Renders messages in the #MENU format as clickable buttons (optional)
webchatPage.sandboxHint: The widget appears in the bottom-right corner.

webhooksPage.title: Webhooks
webhooksPage.helpDesc: Configure webhook URLs to receive real-time events from the system.
webhooksPage.helpS0I0: Enable the webhook and enter the URL that will receive the events
webhooksPage.helpS0I1: Enable 'Message webhook' to receive new message events
webhooksPage.helpS1I0: Configure separate URLs for channel creation and update events
webhooksPage.helpS1I1: Get notified when users are created or updated
webhooksPage.helpS2I0: Check webhook logs to identify events not received or with errors
webhooksPage.helpS2I1: Use a tool like RequestBin to test event reception
webhooksPage.helpS0I2: The URL must be public and accept POST requests over HTTPS.
webhooksPage.helpS1I2: Use tools like n8n or Make to process the received events.

lanesPage.helpS1I2: Deleted lanes remove associated tickets — use with caution.

The 24-hour window for free-form text still applies: after it, only templates can be sent. Meta itself reports the deadline after the business's first reply, and it only exists when the contact wrote from the phone app.

The reply is sent normally, but it reaches the customer as a standalone message, and here in the ticket it is also shown without the quote.

provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpTitle: How to set up the injector (step by step)
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpIntro: Sidecar that connects the channel WITHOUT a QR code by injecting the session straight into the database. One per server (not per user). Code in extra/evo-passkey-injector.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep1: Add the evo-injector service to your Evolution/Evolution Go docker-compose, on the same network as Postgres, using the image zdgzpro/evo-passkey-injector:latest. Ready-made block in docker-compose.example.yml.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep2: Generate a strong secret with openssl rand -hex 32 and set it in INJECTOR_SECRET.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep3Evo: Enable Evolution API by filling the internal Postgres DSN in EVO_DATABASE_URI (the database is never exposed).
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep3Evogo: Enable Evolution Go by filling the two internal DSNs in EVOGO_AUTH_DATABASE_URI and EVOGO_USERS_DATABASE_URI (the database is never exposed).
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep4: Bring the sidecar up with docker compose up -d evo-injector and confirm on GET /health that the backend is enabled.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep5: Paste the injector URL above (same host: http://127.0.0.1:8082; separate host: use HTTPS/reverse-proxy) and the same INJECTOR_SECRET in the Secret field.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpNote: Using both channels on the same sidecar? Point both screens to the same URL and the same secret.

deleteBanned.s1Remote: This number is not in THIS installation (shared license). The system will try to DEREGISTER it at Meta via the Techprovider app — the channel stops working even in another installation — and remove it from the central score monitor. The channel record in the other installation is not deleted (remove it there once you locate it). Own App channels are not affected (Meta rejects our app). To reactivate later: reconnect the channel entering the 6-digit PIN (two-step verification) — a Meta-banned number only comes back if the ban is reverted.
deleteBanned.s1RemoteRev: Blocks the number at Meta + removes from monitor
deleteBanned.s4RemoteDone: Done: number removed from the central monitor and score recalculated. If the Meta deregistration failed (number already deregistered or Own App) and the channel remains active in another installation, it returns to the monitor on the next automatic report.
deleteBanned.otherInstall: This number is not in this installation. If the license is shared, it may belong to another installation — delete it from that panel (or it was already removed).
deleteBanned.title: Delete banned channel
deleteBanned.previewError: Could not load the channel data.
deleteBanned.s1Title: What will be deleted and from where
deleteBanned.s1Intro: Read carefully. Each item shows whether the action is reversible.
deleteBanned.s1Local: Our system: the channel, sessions and settings will be deleted.
deleteBanned.s1Bm: Our Business Manager: we unlink our app from your WABA/Page/Instagram. The number leaves our score.
deleteBanned.s1Dereg: Meta hosting: the number is deregistered from the Cloud API and becomes free to re-register.
deleteBanned.s1DeregRev: Reversible with PIN (a banned number may not come back — Meta's decision)
deleteBanned.s1OwnApp: This channel uses Own App: we do NOT touch Meta — we only remove it from our system. Manage the number in your own Business Manager.
deleteBanned.s1NotRemoved: Note: the WABA and the number are NOT deleted from Meta's Business Manager via API — that is only possible in WhatsApp Manager (manual). We show the steps at the end.
deleteBanned.s1NoUnblock: Deleting does not re-enable Meta connections immediately: re-enabling new connections follows the cooldown period (or manual release).
deleteBanned.s1Accept: I have read and understood what will be deleted and from where.
deleteBanned.s2Title: Confirm that you are the license holder
deleteBanned.s2NoEmail: This license has no email on record. For security, deletion is blocked — please contact support.
deleteBanned.s2Accept: I confirm that I am the holder of this license.
deleteBanned.s3Warning: This action is destructive and cannot be undone on our side.
deleteBanned.s3ConfirmLabel: Type the number ({number}) or the word DELETAR to confirm
deleteBanned.s3Accept: I understand this action is irreversible and I want to proceed.

flowBuilderNodeForm.varGoogleReviewLinkHint: Configured in Reviews. Without a link configured, it comes out empty.

flowBuilderNodeForm.agentTakeoverNote: The agent takes over the conversation from this point on.

flowBuilderNodeForm.condVariableHint: Compares a flow/contact variable, not the message. Routes as soon as the value matches — including right after an API block — and comes BEFORE text conditions. On a node that collects an answer, only when the reply arrives.
flowBuilderNodeForm.webhookResponseHint: With routing set, the flow jumps to the chosen step based on the HTTP result (2xx = success).

flowBuilderNodeForm.action1QueueAutoDistHint: When the customer arrives here via the bot, this step decides the queue. If the queue has Automatic Distribution, it will pick the agent respecting the load limit.
flowBuilderNodeForm.action2UserAutoDistHint: This action assigns the conversation to the chosen agent directly — it ignores the load limit and the queue's Automatic Distribution.
flowBuilderNodeForm.action3CloseAutoDistHint: When ending the conversation, the agent's slot opens up. In queues with Automatic Distribution, this may trigger delivery of a conversation that was waiting.
flowBuilderNodeForm.action4ChannelAutoDistHint: Conversations moved to another channel follow the destination queue's rules — including Automatic Distribution if configured there.

aiAgents.replyDelayHelpHow: For each reply, the agent waits a random time between the minimum and the maximum. The count starts when the customer's message arrives, so the time the AI takes to answer is already included.
aiAgents.replyDelayHelpFixed: With only one field filled in, the time is always the same. With both empty, the agent replies right away, as before.
aiAgents.replyDelayHelpTyping: While waiting, the customer sees "typing..." on Baileys, Zapo, WebJs and official WhatsApp (WABA) connections. On other channels the agent just waits.
aiAgents.replyDelayHelpAlertWaitOn: With message processing wait turned on in the connection, anything the customer writes during the wait is ignored by the AI, including the exit keyword.
aiAgents.replyDelayHelpAlertWaitOff: With that option turned off, each customer message gets its own reply, one after the other.
aiAgents.replyDelayHelpAlertTakeover: If an agent takes over, transfers or closes the ticket during the wait, the AI reply is not sent and its text is kept in an internal note. When the AI itself transfers or closes, its message goes out right away.
aiAgents.replyDelayHelpAlertRead: On official WhatsApp (WABA), "typing..." marks the customer's message as read.
aiAgents.replyDelayHelpAlertLong: Long times keep the customer waiting. The limit is {max} seconds, and if the system restarts during the wait, that reply is not sent.

aiAgents.replyDelayOrder: Reply delay: the minimum cannot be greater than the maximum.

aiAgents.actionsTabIntro: The agent runs these actions on its own during the conversation, whenever the situation you describe in When to use happens.
aiAgents.qualifyPassLabel: Decide tags and funnel after each message
aiAgents.qualifyPassNote: A short AI call, after each customer message, picks the tags and the funnel stage. The reply to the customer does not wait for it.
aiAgents.qualifyPassHelp:
After the agent replies, a short AI call reads the conversation and applies the tags and funnel stage from the cards on this tab, so the agent no longer has to choose between replying and tagging.

Please note:
• It uses one extra AI call per customer message. With the platform AI, it appears as "Agent qualification" in AI Credits.
• The tag appears a few seconds after the reply.
• Each tag and each stage is applied at most once per ticket: anything a team member removes does not come back in that ticket.
• The funnel only moves forward, in the order the board shows the stages.
• "Message to the customer" does not apply to these cards.
• It does not run in groups.
• If the AI provider reports a usage limit or is down, it pauses on its own for 10 minutes.
• When off, the agent goes back to deciding while it replies, as before.

aiAgents.mcpServersHelp: An MCP server is an external service (n8n, Zapier, Make, your store system or your CRM) that offers ready-made tools for the AI to use during a conversation, such as looking up an order or creating a record. Note: the AI sends that service the conversation data it needs to use the tool, so only add services you trust. Each tool turned on in an agent goes into every message of that agent and increases AI usage.
aiAgents.mcpApproveHelp: No tool works until you allow it, and the AI receives exactly the text shown under What the AI receives. If the server changes a tool later, it is paused until you review and allow it again. The check runs on its own once a day; use Refresh tools to check right away.
aiAgents.mcpAltersDataHelp: Check this when the tool saves, changes or deletes something in the target system (for example, creating an order). In that case each use adds an internal note to the ticket, the AI does not repeat the same operation without a new request from the customer, and two messages in a row do not run the operation twice. If the result is not confirmed, the AI tells the customer it is checking and the note asks you to check the target system.
aiAgents.mcpAuthHelp: Choose how the service checks access: no authentication, a Bearer token, a header with the name the service asks for, or an address that already carries the token. The token is stored protected and is never shown again. OAuth login (the service's Connect button) is not supported yet.
aiAgents.mcpUrlHelp: Use the MCP address the service provides, starting with https. Addresses on your internal network (such as n8n on the same server) and http addresses only work with the internal network tools option turned on in Settings > General.
aiAgents.mcpTimeoutHelp: How long the AI waits for each tool of this server to answer, between 5 and 30 seconds. Meanwhile the customer waits for the reply. In each message, MCP tools add up to at most 30 seconds.
aiAgents.mcpSectionHelp: Choose up to 3 servers and the allowed tools this agent can use (up to 15 in total). Each selected tool goes into every message and increases AI usage, so select only what is needed. A tool that changed on the server stays paused until it is allowed again in Manage servers. The AI sends the server the conversation data it needs to use the tool.

aiAgents.helpMcpBody1: In MCP servers you connect external services (n8n, Zapier, Make, your store or your CRM) and allow, one by one, the tools the AI can use. Then, in each agent's Tools tab, choose which allowed tools it uses.
aiAgents.helpMcpBody2: If the service changes a tool, it is paused until allowed again and the button shows how many are paused. Each tool turned on in an agent increases AI usage in every message.

reception.name: Reception
reception.description: Welcomes customers, understands what they need and routes them to the right department.
reception.instructions:
You are the virtual reception of [company name]. Your role is to welcome customers, understand in a few messages what they need and route the conversation to whoever can solve it.

How to help:
- Greet the customer politely and ask how you can help.
- Ask one question at a time and keep messages short.
- As soon as the subject is clear, route to the right destination without asking for unnecessary confirmation.
- Answer simple questions covered by the knowledge base (opening hours, address, contacts) yourself.
- If the customer asks to talk to a person, route to human support.

Never:
- Make up prices, deadlines or rules that are not in the knowledge base.
- Ask for passwords or card details.
reception.faq1A: We are open [days of the week], from [opening time] to [closing time].
reception.faq2A: We are at [full address]. [Landmark, if any].
reception.faq3A: You can talk to [company name] here, by phone at [phone] or by email at [email].
reception.mem1Desc: Summary of what the customer needs
reception.mem2Desc: How the customer heard about the company, if they say

sales.name: Sales
sales.description: Presents products and services, answers purchase questions and gets the customer ready to buy.
sales.routeWhen: When the customer wants to buy, get a quote or ask about price, payment or availability.
sales.instructions:
You are the sales team of [company name]. Your goal is to help the customer choose the right product or service and get them ready to complete the purchase.

How to help:
- Understand what the customer is looking for: what they need it for, quantity and timeline.
- Use the knowledge base to share products, prices, terms and delivery times. If the information is not there, say you will check with the team and route to human support.
- Highlight the benefits that match the customer's needs, without exaggerating.
- When the customer wants to place the order or negotiate special terms, route to human support with a summary of the order.

Never:
- Make up prices, discounts, stock or delivery times.
- Ask for passwords or card details.
sales.faq1Q: Which payment methods do you accept?
sales.faq1A: We accept [payment methods, for example credit card in up to X installments, bank transfer and cash].
sales.faq3Q: Do you offer a discount for upfront payment?
sales.faq3A: [Describe the discount policy or state that there is no discount].
sales.mem1Desc: Product or service the customer wants
sales.mem2Desc: How much the customer plans to spend, if they say

support.name: Support
support.description: Helps solve questions and problems with products or services, step by step.
support.routeWhen: When the customer reports a problem, defect, error or difficulty with something already bought or hired.
support.instructions:
You are the support team of [company name]. Your goal is to understand the customer's problem and solve it with clear guidance, using the knowledge base.

How to help:
- Ask for a description of the problem and, when it makes sense, the order or contract number.
- Confirm what you understood before giving guidance.
- Give guidance in short, numbered steps; if the procedure is long, one step at a time.
- After giving guidance, ask whether the problem was solved.
- If the solution is not in the knowledge base, if the problem persists or if the customer asks, route to human support with a summary of what has already been tried.

Never:
- Make up procedures, repair times or warranty terms.
- Ask for passwords or card details.
support.faq1A: Our products have a [period] warranty against manufacturing defects. To use it, [how to claim the warranty].
support.faq2Q: How do I exchange a defective product?
support.faq2A: [Describe the exchange procedure, the deadline and the conditions].
support.faq3Q: I forgot my password. What should I do?
support.faq3A: Go to [link or path], click [option name] and follow the instructions to create a new password.
support.mem1Desc: Order, contract or ticket number given by the customer

billing.name: Billing
billing.description: Answers questions about invoices, payments, bills and duplicate copies.
billing.routeWhen: When the subject is an invoice, payment, bill, duplicate copy, charge, refund or tax receipt.
billing.instructions:
You are the billing team of [company name]. Your goal is to answer questions about payments, invoices and charges clearly and respectfully.

How to help:
- Identify the subject: duplicate copy, payment confirmation, question about an amount, refund or tax receipt.
- Use the knowledge base to explain deadlines, payment methods and procedures.
- To check a specific payment, issue a duplicate copy, negotiate amounts or handle a refund, route to human support with the order or invoice number.
- When collecting payments, be polite and never embarrass the customer.

Never:
- Confirm payments, amounts or discounts that are not in the knowledge base.
- Ask for passwords or card details.
billing.faq1Q: How do I get a copy of my invoice?
billing.faq1A: You can get a copy at [link or path]. If you prefer, the team can send it here.
billing.faq2Q: How long does it take to confirm a payment?
billing.faq2A: Card payments are confirmed in [timeframe]; bank transfers in up to [timeframe] business days.
billing.faq3Q: How do I request a refund?
billing.faq3A: [Describe the refund policy, the deadlines and how to request it].
billing.mem1Desc: Order, invoice or bill number given by the customer
billing.mem2Desc: Type of request: duplicate copy, refund, question about an amount or other

scheduling.name: Scheduling
scheduling.description: Helps the customer book, reschedule or cancel appointments.
scheduling.routeWhen: When the customer wants to book, reschedule, confirm or cancel an appointment, consultation or visit.
scheduling.instructions:
You are the scheduling team of [company name]. Your goal is to help the customer book, reschedule or cancel appointments.

How to help:
- Ask which service the customer wants and their preferred date and time of day.
- Use the knowledge base to share the services, their duration and the opening hours.
- Before finishing, repeat the service, date and time and ask the customer to confirm.
- If you have the scheduling tool, use it to check available times and book. If you do not, note the preferences and route to human support to finish.
- To reschedule or cancel, ask for the details of the current appointment and route to human support when you cannot do it yourself.

Never:
- Confirm a time that you have not actually booked.
- Make up available times.
scheduling.faq1Q: How far in advance do I need to book?
scheduling.faq1A: We recommend booking [lead time] in advance. [Rules for last-minute appointments].
scheduling.faq2A: Yes. Changes and cancellations must be made at least [minimum notice] in advance. [No-show rules].
scheduling.faq3Q: How long does the appointment take?
scheduling.mem1Desc: Service the customer wants to book
scheduling.mem2Desc: Customer's preferred date and time of day

post_sale.name: After-sales
post_sale.description: Follows up on orders, handles exchanges and returns and listens to customer feedback.
post_sale.routeWhen: When the customer talks about an order already placed: delivery, exchange, return, warranty or review.
post_sale.instructions:
You are the after-sales team of [company name]. Your goal is to make sure the customer is satisfied after the purchase.

How to help:
- Ask for the order number to find the case.
- Use the knowledge base to explain delivery times and the exchange, return and warranty rules.
- If the customer is satisfied, thank them and, when it makes sense, ask whether they would recommend the company.
- If there is a complaint, show empathy, record what happened and route to human support with a summary.
- To track a specific order or approve an exchange, return or refund, route to human support.

Never:
- Promise deadlines, exchanges or refunds that are not covered in the knowledge base.
- Ask for passwords or card details.
post_sale.faq1Q: How long do I have to exchange a product?
post_sale.faq1A: You can request an exchange up to [number] days after receiving the product, [conditions].
post_sale.faq2Q: My order has not arrived. What should I do?
post_sale.faq2A: Check the tracking at [link]. If the [timeframe] delivery time has passed, the team will check it for you.
post_sale.faq3Q: How do I return a product?
post_sale.faq3A: [Describe the return procedure and who pays for shipping].
post_sale.mem1Desc: Order number given by the customer
post_sale.mem2Desc: How the customer rated the purchase, in their own words
