configGeralPage.helpS11I0: Each field can follow the global default or have a value just for this company. With nothing set, Brazil, real and Portuguese apply
configGeralPage.helpS11I1: Country: sets the flag the phone field opens with, the number examples and the format of money amounts
configGeralPage.helpS11I2: Currency: appears in prices and amounts. Amounts already saved are not converted, only the displayed currency changes
configGeralPage.helpS11I3: Language of customer messages: applies to automated messages, such as the satisfaction survey and the queue position. After changing it, use Apply default texts in the language to switch the saved texts that are still default
configGeralPage.aiAgentPrivateWebhookDesc: Lets AI Agent external tools and MCP servers reach addresses on your internal network.
configGeralPage.aiAgentPrivateWebhookNote: Turn on only if your automation or MCP server runs on the same server or on your private network. When off, only public addresses are accepted.
configGeralPage.notifyOnlyHumanTicketsDesc: When enabled, the notification sound and popup do not fire while the ticket is in the chatbot (automatic flow). You are alerted only when the ticket moves to a human agent (pending in a queue or assigned).
configGeralPage.notifyOnlyHumanTicketsNote: How it works: while the ticket is in the chatbot (automatic flow active, still without a queue or agent), the sound and popup stay muted. When the flow routes the ticket to a queue or assigns it to an agent, notifications resume. The ticket list and the bell keep updating. Push notifications on the phone and on a closed browser are also muted during this time; alerts the flow itself sends to the team still arrive.
configGeralPage.crossChannelTicketCheckDesc: When starting conversations, warns if the same contact already has an open or pending ticket on another channel. In mass dispatches, contacts that already have an open or pending ticket do NOT receive the dispatch.
configGeralPage.crossChannelTicketCheckNote: How it works: the check matches the contact's number across all of the tenant's WhatsApp channels. In conversations (New Conversation, Contacts, Kanban and Pending) it shows a warning and never blocks. In Mass Dispatch and campaigns, contacts with an open or waiting ticket do NOT receive the message — they appear as skipped in the summary and the dispatch owner gets a notification.
configGeralPage.aiEngineDesc: Which OpenAI API the assistants use: Automatic uses the new engine (Responses) and keeps old tickets on the legacy one until they close. The Assistants API shuts down on 08/26/2026.
configGeralPage.scheduleRoutingWindowDesc: When a scheduled message has a queue/user configured, the contact's reply within this window goes straight to the destination, skipping the chatbot. 0 = disabled.
configGeralPage.autoDisableIntegrationsOnAcceptDesc: When accepting a pending ticket, automatically turns off the ticket's bots and AI integrations
configGeralPage.autoDistEnabledTitle: Automatic Distribution active in some queue
configGeralPage.autoDistEnabledDesc: The settings below marked with a notice interact with Automatic Distribution by Queue — for conversations in queues with the option enabled, some rules on this page are ignored or adjusted. Hover over each item to understand the effect.
configGeralPage.forcarAdminAutoDistNote: In queues with Automatic Distribution enabled, this option is ignored for conversations of that queue — the queue picks the agent respecting the load limit.
configGeralPage.directTicketsToWalletsAutoDistNote: Customers with a fixed agent (portfolio) always go to their agent, with priority over the queue's Automatic Distribution — even if the agent is at the limit.
configGeralPage.transbordoAutoDistNote: When portfolio transfer is enabled, it takes priority over the queue's Automatic Distribution.
configGeralPage.reopenTicketAssignsToActorAutoDistNote: In queues with Automatic Distribution, reopened conversations return to the waiting queue to be redistributed respecting the limit — they do not go directly to whoever reopened.
configGeralPage.title: General Settings
configGeralPage.queuePositionGlobalEnabledLabel: Enable queue position for all channels
configGeralPage.queuePositionGlobalEnabledHint: Notifies the customer of their position when a ticket enters the queue. Channels can override individually.
configGeralPage.queuePositionAvgHint: Value shown to the customer in the message.
configGeralPage.queuePositionMessagePlaceholder:
Hello {{name}}! You are #{{position}} in the queue.
Average waiting time is about {{avgWait}} minutes.
Thank you for your patience.
configGeralPage.resetFlowMsg: Do you want to reset the active flow for new tickets?
configGeralPage.forceMessageMsg: This command will send stuck messages in the system.
configGeralPage.forceMessageDesc: This command will send stuck messages in the system.
configGeralPage.resolveMessagesMsg: This command will remove messages with errors from the system.
configGeralPage.resolveMessagesDesc: This command will remove messages with errors from the system.
configGeralPage.validateContactsMsg: Caution: many contacts may cause WhatsApp blocking. Validate all contacts in bulk?
configGeralPage.validateContactsDesc: This command will validate the number of all contacts in the system.
configGeralPage.syncMessagesMsg: Do you want to update the dates of synced messages?
configGeralPage.syncMessagesDesc: This option updates imported message dates to their original timestamp.
configGeralPage.syncTicketsMsg: Do you want to update ticket dates to the latest message time?
configGeralPage.syncTicketsDesc: This option updates ticket dates to the latest message timestamp.
configGeralPage.normalizeBirthdaysDesc: Standardizes contacts' birthday dates to YYYY-MM-DD, fixing imported or legacy records where the day and month may be swapped (which makes the birthday message fire on the wrong day).
configGeralPage.normalizeBirthdaysMsg: This goes through this tenant's contacts and standardizes the birthday dates. Dates that cannot be safely interpreted are kept as-is. Do you want to continue?
configGeralPage.scanContactsMsg: This process will scan your entire database and update all contacts without LID. On very large databases, this may take a while or trigger an account block.
configGeralPage.scanContactsDesc: This option will start searching and updating contacts without LID.
configGeralPage.lidConsolidationDesc: Detects and merges contact pairs duplicated by LID/PN cross-collision. Destructive operation — backup required.
configGeralPage.instagramPkSanitizeDesc: Detects Instagram contacts with instagramPK corrupted by JSON parser overflow and fixes them by cross-referencing the Meta API.
configGeralPage.leaveMessage: You changed settings that have not been saved yet. If you leave now, they will be lost.
configGeralPage.ticketsVisibilityDesc: Control who can see which tickets
configGeralPage.notViewAssignedTickets: Do not view tickets already assigned to other users
configGeralPage.notViewAssignedTicketsDesc: Only the ticket owner and admins can view.
configGeralPage.notViewAssignedTicketsNote: How it works: agents, supervisors with "Remove supervisor viewing privileges" and custom profiles without "View all tickets" can no longer see, open or act on another agent's ongoing ticket, including in the Tickets Panel and in push notifications. Administrators and supervisors without this restriction keep access, but in the list they need to check "Show all" or filter by queue to see their colleagues' tickets.
configGeralPage.adminOnlyOptionHint: Only an administrator can change this option.
configGeralPage.notViewTicketsChatBotDesc: No user can see tickets handled by the ChatBot.
configGeralPage.directTicketsToWalletsDesc: Routes tickets to the owners of the customer portfolio.
configGeralPage.ticketNulo: View tickets without an assigned agent
configGeralPage.ticketNuloDesc: All users will see tickets that don't have an agent yet, from any queue or without a queue, on the channels allowed to each of them. A ticket without a queue that already has an agent is not covered by this option.
configGeralPage.supervisorChannelScopedDesc: When enabled, the supervisor keeps elevated privileges (sees other agents' queues and tickets) but only sees tickets from the channels assigned to them. No effect when the supervisor is already limited to a regular user.
configGeralPage.customProfileEnabledDesc: Allows creating reusable custom access profiles for users with profile=custom.
configGeralPage.userPaymentsEnabledDesc: When enabled, regular agents can also send the charge template (Pix, link or bank slip) using the channel key. When off, only administrators and supervisors can charge.
configGeralPage.privacidadeFunilDesc: When enabled, regular users and supervisors only see their own opportunities. Pipelines, actions and logs are restricted to admins.
configGeralPage.semRedisDesc: Messages will be sent without cadencing.
configGeralPage.botFlowActive: Active flow for the service bot
configGeralPage.botFlowActiveDesc: Flow to be used by the Bot for new tickets
configGeralPage.ignoreGroupMsgDesc: System will not open tickets for groups.
configGeralPage.ignorarStoriesDesc: When enabled, Instagram Stories will be ignored.
configGeralPage.mostrarGruposParaTodosDesc: When enabled, Groups will be visible to all users.
configGeralPage.mostrarFechadoParaTodosDesc: When enabled, Closed tickets will be visible to all users.
configGeralPage.rejectCallsDesc: Audio and video calls will receive the message below.
configGeralPage.chatbotLaneDesc: Adds a tab to the tickets screen with conversations where a chatbot, an AI agent or an integration (ChatGPT, Typebot, N8N and others) is turned on.
configGeralPage.fixarConexao: Pin connections at the top of the ticket list
configGeralPage.fixarConexaoDesc: When this option is enabled, connections will no longer float in the footer and will be pinned at the top of the ticket list.
configGeralPage.forcarPendente: Force current user when changing the status of a pending ticket
configGeralPage.forcarPendenteDesc: The ticket will keep the associated user when status changes from open to pending.
configGeralPage.agruparTicketsDesc: Shows all messages associated with the channel and contact.
configGeralPage.messageListingTypeDesc: Defines how messages are listed in the history.
configGeralPage.messageListingTypeNote: Default follows the Group Tickets option. By Queue: the agent sees only messages from their queues. Complete: everyone sees the contact's full history. By Ticket: only the current ticket. By User: each agent sees only their own conversation, hiding other agents' replies and notes (admin and supervisor-admin see everything).
configGeralPage.scheduleSentNotice: Notify in history when a scheduled message is sent
configGeralPage.scheduleSentNoticeDesc: Marks in the conversation the moment the scheduled message was sent.
configGeralPage.scheduleSentNoticeNote: Inserts a notice in the conversation when the scheduled message goes out, so the customer's reply makes sense in order.
configGeralPage.videoConferenceProviderDesc: Defines the link sent when using the video call button in the chat. Google Meet requires Google Calendar configured.
configGeralPage.listarPelaUltimaMensagemDesc: On: the ticket list follows the last message sent or received, the same time shown on the card. Off: it follows the ticket's last activity (message, acceptance, transfer, bot action), so an old ticket with recent activity moves up while the card still shows the time of its last message.
configGeralPage.ordemReversaListaDesc: Tenant setting: oldest to newest. Request param: orderAsc=true does the same. Otherwise, default order applies.
configGeralPage.validateContactDesc: When enabled, the system validates the contact number (WABA).
configGeralPage.brPhoneConventionDesc: Sets how the system automatically fixes the 9th digit of Brazilian mobile numbers when creating contacts and sending messages.
configGeralPage.brPhoneConventionNote: Area code rule: adds the 9 for area codes below 30 and removes it for 30 or above (historical behavior). Always with 9: mobile numbers always keep the 9th digit, which is never removed — recommended for current numbers. If a message fails because the number does not exist, the system automatically retries with the other 9th-digit variant. With Validate Contact turned off, no automatic correction is applied.
configGeralPage.userCreationPasswordModeDesc: Defines how newly created users receive their first access password.
configGeralPage.userCreationPasswordModeNote: Set by admin: you type the password and share it with the user (default). Change on first login: you set a temporary password and the user must create their own password the first time they sign in. Email invite: the form does not ask for a password — the user receives an email link (valid for 7 days) to create their own password. Email options require SMTP to be configured.
configGeralPage.hearHubApiDesc: When enabled, all messages are created via HUB API with system user.
configGeralPage.ticketsRainDesc: Filter before processing, ignoring tickets that do not belong to the user (except admin). Recommended for high volume.
configGeralPage.carteiraExterna: Disable external integrations when portfolio assignment is active
configGeralPage.carteiraExternaDesc: When enabled, external integrations such as ChatGPT, Typebot and others are disabled when portfolio assignment is active.
configGeralPage.walletShowAll: Allow all agents to see portfolio contacts
configGeralPage.walletShowAllDesc: When enabled, all agents can view and search contacts even if they are assigned to another user's portfolio.
configGeralPage.contactDeleteAdminOnly: Allow only admins to delete contacts
configGeralPage.contactDeleteAdminOnlyDesc: When enabled, only administrators can delete contacts. Supervisors and regular agents will not see the delete button.
configGeralPage.hidePaymentsFromUsers: Hide payment info from regular users (privacy)
configGeralPage.hidePaymentsFromUsersDesc: When enabled, only administrators can see subscription, invoices and billing alerts. Recommended for data privacy compliance — regular users should not see the contractor's financial data.
configGeralPage.inboundByQueueOnlyDesc: When enabled, agents receive incoming tickets based solely on assigned queues (no channel link required). Outbound (New Conversation) still requires the channel linked to the user.
configGeralPage.reopenTicketAssignsToActorDesc: When enabled, reopening a ticket closed by another agent reassigns it to the user who clicked Reopen, instead of keeping it with the previous agent.
configGeralPage.youtubeCommentsCreateTicketsDesc: When enabled, each new YouTube video comment creates a support ticket. Disable to manage comments only via the /youtube-comentarios page without flooding the queue.
configGeralPage.esperarProcessamento: Enable wait in message processing with external integrations
configGeralPage.esperarProcessamentoDesc: When more than one message is received in a ticket, the system will only process new messages after the first one has been answered.
configGeralPage.transbordoDesc: Overflows portfolio tickets if the user is offline.
configGeralPage.janelaConversa: Enable WABA message sending outside window
configGeralPage.janelaConversaDesc: Enables WABA message sending after any template, even if the conversation window is not open. Delivery is not guaranteed. Check the WABA policies.
configGeralPage.atualizarNomes: Do not update name when receiving messages
configGeralPage.atualizarNomesDesc: Does not update contact name on received messages.
configGeralPage.bsuidStrictModeDesc: Applies Meta's strict mode to the send checks. Contacts without a phone number already use the dedicated field automatically.
configGeralPage.forcarAdminDesc: Pending tickets will be assigned to admin.
configGeralPage.uazapiDisableLidDesc: When enabled, contacts received via UAZAPI with @lid will not be marked as isLid in the database.
configGeralPage.controleFeaturesDesc: When enabled, controls spy and forced closure features for users.
configGeralPage.forceReason: Force demand definition when closing a ticket
configGeralPage.forceReasonDesc: When this option is enabled, the system will require a demand definition when closing a ticket.
configGeralPage.allowPauseDesc: When this option is enabled, the system will allow the ticket to be paused temporarily.
configGeralPage.offlineOnTabClose: Go offline when the tab is closed
configGeralPage.offlineOnTabCloseDesc: When enabled, closing the last open tab or window automatically marks the user as offline (same effect as the 'go offline' logout option). Reloading the page (F5) does not drop the status and other open tabs are taken into account. When disabled, closing the tab does not change the status (current behavior).
configGeralPage.autoUnpauseOnReplyDesc: When enabled, a paused ticket is automatically resumed as soon as the customer sends a new message; after the operator replies, it is automatically paused again, until the customer speaks again. When disabled, the ticket stays paused until the operator resumes it manually (current behavior).
configGeralPage.allowDuplicateMessagesDesc: When enabled, the same message received by more than one of the company's connections (e.g., two channels in the same group, or channels messaging each other) is recorded in each corresponding ticket. Note: automatic replies (chatbot, AI, rating) are blocked for messages coming from another connection of the same company to prevent loops; external integrations and webhooks will receive the message once per connection; and metrics count each copy. When disabled, only the first channel records the message (current behavior).
configGeralPage.contactEventsRetentionDaysDesc: How long to keep the events in the contact timeline (funnel, tags, portfolio and profile).
configGeralPage.contactEventsRetentionNote: Events older than this period are deleted overnight and cannot be recovered. Tickets, messages and campaigns are not affected.
configGeralPage.groupTimeMetricsEnabledDesc: When enabled, group conversations are included in the report time averages (waiting and handling times). When disabled, groups are left out of these averages and their time columns appear blank in reports — ticket counts still include groups. Useful when group chats distort team indicators.
configGeralPage.botReopenGraceDesc: If the customer replies within the defined period after closing, the ticket reopens in Open assigned to the agent who handled it, skipping the chatbot. After the grace period, replies follow the normal flow (pending/chatbot).
configGeralPage.botReopenGraceScenarios:
How it works in practice:
• Open satisfaction survey: the score sent by the customer is recorded normally and the conversation stays closed.
• Conversation closed by the bot: it does not reopen — the customer's reply goes back to the bot.
• Closed from the list by someone else: it reopens for whoever closed it, not for the original agent.
• Agent offline: if automatic redistribution is on, the reopened conversation may go to another agent.
• Flow keyword: if the customer's reply contains a word that triggers a flow, the bot may take over the conversation even during the grace period.
• Does not work in groups or the webchat channel.
configGeralPage.universalCounterDesc: Shows open ticket counter on top tabs.
configGeralPage.pluginAudioDesc: When enabled, a new beta audio plugin will be used.
configGeralPage.audioModuloDesc: When enabled, a new audio module with sound waves will be used.
configGeralPage.persistirMediaDesc: When enabled, sequential attempts are made to download media received via Baileys.
configGeralPage.useUserBusinessHoursDesc: When enabled, the system uses the business hours of each user (agent) to define the business hours on the days the company hours are set to "Scheduled". On the agent's schedule for that day, "Open" counts as within hours all day and "Closed" as outside. An agent with no hours set for that day of the week counts as within hours.
configGeralPage.webPushChatInternoDesc: When enabled, push notifications are sent for new internal chat messages.
configGeralPage.pushNotificationLimitToOwnerDesc: By default, push notifications are delivered to: administrators (all), agents with permission for the ticket's WhatsApp connection and queue, and the agent assigned to the ticket. When enabled, notifications will be sent exclusively to the direct recipient of the message, regardless of profile.
configGeralPage.notificationSilencedDesc: Receive audio notifications. When off, no one in the company hears alert sounds in the panel, the browser or on the iPhone; the Android app keeps playing sound. Each user can also turn off the sound just for themselves, or only for groups, with the sound button at the top, which is the only way to silence the Android app.
configGeralPage.pushMessagePreviewDesc: When enabled, the notification shows the contact name and a snippet of the received message. When disabled, it shows only the contact name and a new message notice - suitable for teams that must keep customer content off the lock screen.
configGeralPage.pushDuplicateSuppression: Avoid repeated notification in the browser
configGeralPage.pushDuplicateSuppressionDesc: When enabled, people who have the app installed on their phone stop receiving the same notification in the browser as well, ending the duplicate alert. It applies only to those who opened the app in the last 7 days; anyone who stopped using it is notified in the browser again. Disabled by default.
configGeralPage.autoClose: Automatically resolve tickets with no interaction
configGeralPage.autoCloseDesc: Idle tickets will be resolved automatically.
configGeralPage.autoCloseChannelOverrideNote: Some channels can have their own inactivity-closing rule, set on the Connections screen. When a channel has its own rule, it applies instead of this general setting.
configGeralPage.autoCloseOfficialWindowNote: On official WhatsApp (WABA, Dialog360 and Gupshup), if the contact's last message is more than 24 hours old, automatic closing closes the ticket without sending the message, file or rating: Meta would refuse sending outside the 24-hour window.
configGeralPage.ticketLimitDaysDesc: Tickets older than this number of days will be filtered.
configGeralPage.tentativas: Maximum attempts for the business hours message
configGeralPage.tentativasDesc: Enter the number of times the absence message can be sent for each ticket.
configGeralPage.limiteTickets: Number of tickets queried on the Tickets screen
configGeralPage.limiteTicketsDesc: Enter the number of tickets to be fetched on the Tickets screen.
configGeralPage.limiteChatInterno: Number of messages in the internal chat per ticket
configGeralPage.limiteChatInternoDesc: Enter the number of messages to be loaded in the internal chat per ticket.
configGeralPage.forbiddenNumbersDesc: List of numbers blocked on the platform.
configGeralPage.helpDesc: These settings control who can see which tickets, how the list is sorted, and which rules apply to each user profile.
configGeralPage.helpS0T: Profiles and what each one sees
configGeralPage.helpS0I0: Administrators always see all tickets, regardless of any setting below
configGeralPage.helpS0I1: Supervisors: if 'Remove supervisor privileges' is OFF, the supervisor has the same view as admin. If ON, they follow the same rules as a regular user
configGeralPage.helpS0I2: Regular users see only tickets from the queues they were added to, tickets assigned to them and tickets from contacts in their portfolio
configGeralPage.helpS1T: Do not view tickets assigned to others
configGeralPage.helpS1I0: When ON, regular users and supervisors (without privileges) see only: tickets assigned to themselves, unassigned tickets (within their queues), and groups where they were included
configGeralPage.helpS1I1: Administrators and supervisors with privileges ignore this rule - they always see all tickets, even when filtering by queue
configGeralPage.helpS1I2: If 'Show Closed for all' or 'Show Groups for all' are enabled, those tickets remain visible even with this option active
configGeralPage.helpS2I0: When ON, tickets still being processed by the chatbot (no assigned agent and no defined queue) are hidden from all users
configGeralPage.helpS2I1: This keeps the list from being cluttered with conversations the bot hasn't forwarded to human service yet
configGeralPage.helpS3T: Tickets without an owner and portfolios
configGeralPage.helpS3I0: 'View tickets without an assigned agent': when ON, all users see tickets that don't have an agent yet, from any queue or without a queue. A ticket without a queue that already has an agent is not included. When OFF, agents only see the unassigned ones from their own queues
configGeralPage.helpS3I1: 'Force service via portfolio': when ON, new tickets are automatically routed to the owner of the contact's portfolio
configGeralPage.helpS3I2: Even if a ticket is not in your queue, you will see it if the contact is in your portfolio
configGeralPage.helpS4I0: 'Show Groups for all': when OFF, regular users only see groups in their queues. When ON (or not set), everyone sees all groups
configGeralPage.helpS4I1: 'Show Closed for all': when OFF, only administrators can see closed tickets. When ON, everyone can view them
configGeralPage.helpS4I2: 'Ignore Group Messages': when ON, no group tickets appear in the list for any profile
configGeralPage.helpS5I0: Each supervisor can have 'View only my department' enabled in their user profile
configGeralPage.helpS5I1: When active, the supervisor sees only tickets from their assigned queues, even if they have admin privileges
configGeralPage.helpS6I0: Each user can have specific connections (WhatsApp, Instagram, etc.) defined in their profile
configGeralPage.helpS6I1: If the user has defined connections, they will only see tickets from those connections. Administrators always see all
configGeralPage.helpS7I0: 'Sort by last message': orders the list by the most recent message time, not by the ticket update date
configGeralPage.helpS7I1: 'Reverse order': shows the oldest tickets first instead of the most recent
configGeralPage.helpS7I2: 'Filter old tickets': hides tickets that had no activity within the configured number of days
configGeralPage.helpS8I0: When ON, the system only notifies the user about their own tickets, reducing processing in environments with many simultaneous messages
configGeralPage.helpS8I1: Administrators continue receiving notifications for all tickets, even with this option active
configGeralPage.helpS9I0: Admin: sees everything, always. No visibility setting restricts them
configGeralPage.helpS9I1: Supervisor without removed privileges: same view as admin
configGeralPage.helpS9I2: Supervisor with removed privileges: follows the same rules as a regular user
configGeralPage.helpS9I3: Regular user: sees tickets from their queues + assigned to them + their portfolio. The options above restrict or expand this view
configGeralPage.helpS10I0: When a new ticket enters as pending, the system sends an automatic message to the customer informing their position in the queue and the configured average waiting time
configGeralPage.helpS10I1: The value set here is the tenant default for all channels. Each channel can override this in 'Channel Features' of the session (inherit / enable / disable)
configGeralPage.helpS10I2: The message is sent only once per ticket, after the chatbot/flow finishes. If the ticket is already assigned to an agent or a chatbot takes over, the message is not fired
configGeralPage.wabaCallRoutingDesc: Defines who rings when a customer calls via WABA
configGeralPage.wabaCallRoutingAssignedTicket: Only agent of the open ticket
configGeralPage.wabaCallFallbackSecondsDesc: After this time without an answer, rings the next agent in the queue
configGeralPage.windowTimerBannerDesc: Shows the 24h window countdown at the top of the chat on WABA, Hub, Instagram and Messenger channels
configGeralPage.wabaTemplateBannerDesc: Shows the notice to use templates outside the 24h window at the top of the WABA chat
configGeralPage.wabaTemplateBannerMsgDesc: Customize the message. Leave empty to use the default text
configGeralPage.wabaTemplateBannerMsgPlaceholder: WABA channel: use templates to start conversations outside the 24h window.
configGeralPage.freeEntryWindowBannerDesc: Shows in the chat until when templates are free of charge in conversations started from an ad that opens WhatsApp (WABA and Dialog360 channels)
configGeralPage.freeEntryWindowBannerNote: Meta itself reports the deadline (up to 7 days), and the notice only appears after the business's first reply, sent within 24 hours of the contact's message. It is only a cost notice: after 24 hours without a message from the contact, only templates can still be sent.
configGeralPage.windowClosedBannerDesc: Shows the notice that the 24h window has closed at the top of the chat (WABA, Instagram and Messenger channels). The send template button remains available in the actions menu
configGeralPage.directTicketsToContactQueue: Route tickets to the contact's Queue
configGeralPage.directTicketsToContactQueueDesc: New tickets from contacts that have a queue set in their profile automatically enter that queue.
configGeralPage.botReopenDestinationHint: When the customer replies shortly after the ticket is closed, choose where the conversation goes back to (the same agent, whoever closed it, a queue, a fixed agent or a chatbot) — without going through the initial menu.

botsEIaPage.followRegionNote: When following the Region, the AI uses the customer message language set in the Region and language card, in Settings. With no language set there, it replies in Portuguese.
botsEIaPage.followRegionTooltip: Choose a language to lock the AI to it. With Follow the Region, the AI follows the company's language: if it changes later, the AI switches to the new language without you coming back here.
botsEIaPage.helpS0I2Region: With no language chosen, the AI follows the company's customer message language; if that is not set, it uses Portuguese
botsEIaPage.title: Bots & AI
botsEIaPage.languageDescription: Language used by the AI when describing received images and media, and when suggesting or rewriting messages to the customer in tickets.
botsEIaPage.helpDesc: Set the default language used by AI when analyzing images and media, and when suggesting or rewriting messages to the customer.
botsEIaPage.helpS0I0: AI describes images in the language configured here
botsEIaPage.helpS0I1: Affects image analysis via ChatGPT, GPT-4o and Gemini
botsEIaPage.helpS0I2: Defaults to Portuguese if no language is selected
botsEIaPage.helpS1I0: Configure the tenant language according to your customers' language
botsEIaPage.helpS1I1: Tenants with customers in different languages can choose the most common one

channelHistoryImport.title: Import conversation history
channelHistoryImport.description: Import a .zip exported from the WhatsApp Business app (Settings > Chats > Export chat) into any channel already registered.
channelHistoryImport.noteTitle: Imported messages do not trigger automations
channelHistoryImport.noteDesc: Tickets created from the import start with status 'closed' and an 'imported' marker. Chatbot, AI, n8n, external webhooks and push notifications are not triggered.
channelHistoryImport.step1Desc: Choose which channel of this tenant the imported messages will be associated with.

customizarPage.socketModelWarningIntro: Optimized mode applies a 1.5s debounce and a 2s cache to ticket list socket events to reduce server queries. This can cause the following behaviors:
customizarPage.socketModelWarningBullet1: Queue or user assignments made by chat flow may not appear immediately in the open ticket view. If the ticket is not in the current list (filter applied, not on page 1, or not assigned to the agent), the queue may only show after F5 or after leaving and reopening the ticket.

customizarPage.socketModelWarningBullet4: F5, reopening the ticket, or a socket reconnect always fetch fresh state from the server.
customizarPage.socketModelWarningRecommendation: Recommended only for installations with more than 25 simultaneous users or more than 1500 tickets per day. For smaller environments, the standard mode offers instant updates with no performance cost.

dashboardPage.widgetsDesc: Show, hide and reorder cards and charts. Drag by the handles to reorder.
dashboardPage.tprInfo: After the conversation reaches the agent, how long they take to send the first reply to the customer. Tickets with a chatbot, flow or AI are counted too: the clock starts when the conversation is handed to an agent (by the automation, by the queue distribution or when the agent clicks Accept; outside service hours, always on the click), and automatic messages do not stop it. Replies sent through the API on the ticket itself also count as a reply. Only conversations started by the customer are counted. Tickets from before this indicator was added are not included.
dashboardPage.tteInfo: Total time the customer waited, from their first message until receiving the first reply from an agent. Tickets with a chatbot, flow or AI are counted too: time spent with the automation is part of the wait, and automatic messages do not stop the clock. Replies sent through the API on the ticket itself also count as a reply. Only conversations started by the customer are counted. Tickets from before this indicator was added are not included.

dashboardPage.tmeInfo: Average time the customer waits from their first contact until the conversation is assigned to an agent.

migrationPage.renamedEmailsDesc: These users already had their email registered on this server. To avoid a login conflict, the email got a suffix. Let each of them know the new email.

migrationPage.errRepairNoDbPhase: This migration brought only files, no database data, so there is no history to repair.
migrationPage.errRepairPassword: Enter the old server's database password for the exact repair.
migrationPage.errRepairSourceUnreachable: Could not connect to the old server's database. Check the password and whether it is still online, or use the approximate mode.
migrationPage.errRepairDisabled: History repair is turned off on this server.
migrationPage.errRepairAlreadyPreserved: This migration already preserved the history. There is nothing to repair.
migrationPage.errRepairMapsUnavailable: This server is not ready for history repair yet: the database still needs to be updated.
migrationPage.errRepairSourceTenantNotFound: The source company was not found in the old server's database. Check that it is the same database used in the migration.

migrationPage.errRepairGeneric: An unexpected error happened during the repair. Try again; if it persists, contact support.
migrationPage.errRepairTargetPreexisting: The target company already existed before this migration. The repair was blocked so it does not touch data created there.

avaliacoesPage.googleReviewTooltip: When the customer answers the survey with the rating, the reply to the rating goes out with the Google review request at the end, in the same message. It works in the channels with the satisfaction survey. On Instagram and Messenger, if the message goes over the channel limit, it goes out without the request. After saving, the change may take up to 2 minutes to apply to all conversations.

avaliacoesPage.googleReviewToggleLabel: Ask for a Google review after the rating

avaliacoesPage.googleReviewUrlHint: Where to find it: in the Google Business Profile, open Ask for reviews and copy the link. With the Google tab connected, the Use this listing's link in the review request button fills in this field.
avaliacoesPage.googleReviewUrlInvalid: Invalid link. Use an address that starts with https://, without spaces, quotes, braces, backslash or the greater-than and less-than signs, up to 1000 characters.
avaliacoesPage.googleReviewUrlRequired: To ask for a Google review, enter the link.
avaliacoesPage.googleReviewTextHint: Empty = default text in the company language (the field example). Use {variable} to place the link; without it, the link goes at the end of the text. It also accepts the company variables. Up to {max} characters.
avaliacoesPage.googleReviewPolicyNote: The request goes to all ratings, good and bad, and cannot offer anything in return. Google policy forbids asking for reviews only from satisfied customers: this can lead to reviews being removed and the company listing being suspended on Google.
avaliacoesPage.googleReviewVariableHint: The link also works as {variable} in funnel actions, in the flow, in quick replies, in the farewell message and in the reply to the rating itself. It does not work in campaigns or in ticket actions.
avaliacoesPage.googleReviewTextTooLong: The request text is longer than {max} characters.
avaliacoesPage.googleReviewTextInvalid: The request text could not be saved. Review the text and try again.

avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorLabel: What to do after sending the satisfaction survey
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorHint: Choose what happens to the conversation as soon as the agent clicks Resolve and the satisfaction survey is sent to the customer.
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorAskDesc: When resolving, the system asks the agent whether to close the conversation right away or keep it open (current behavior).
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorCloseOnResolveDesc: When resolving, the survey is sent and the conversation is closed immediately. If the customer replies later, the rating is still recorded, but the conversation stays closed.
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorWaitReply: Keep open until the customer replies
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorWaitReplyDesc: When resolving, the survey is sent and the conversation stays open. It only closes when the customer answers the survey.
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorTimer: Keep open for a few minutes
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorTimerDesc: When resolving, the conversation stays open waiting for the reply. If the customer does not answer within the set time, it closes on its own. If the customer sends a new message before that, the conversation continues normally.
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorStoreUseWarning: For a rating sent after closing to be recorded, keep the Record rating option (below) turned on.
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorLinkModeNote: In external link mode there is no waiting for a reply: the conversation is always closed on resolve, whatever option you choose here.
avaliacoesPage.closeBehaviorChannelNote: This rule only applies to channels that have automatic evaluation turned on.

chatFlowAudience.scheduleToggleDesc: When on, this flow's bot only replies within the time windows. Outside them it stays silent.
chatFlowAudience.scheduleNoWindows: No windows added. The bot runs at any time.
chatFlowAudience.enabledToggleDesc: When disabled, this flow follows the default behavior (no filtering)
chatFlowAudience.maxAgeDays: Consider as new if created within N days
chatFlowAudience.tagsIncludePlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
chatFlowAudience.tagsExcludePlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
chatFlowAudience.priorityHint: Higher value evaluated first on ties
chatFlowAudience.helpIntro: Each chatflow only triggers for contacts that pass all configured filters (AND between fields). When nothing is set, it applies to everyone.
chatFlowAudience.helpAudienceAll: Available for any contact — default behavior when no audience is configured.
chatFlowAudience.helpAudienceNew: Only for those who never opened a ticket in this tenant before (or were created within the configured time window below).
chatFlowAudience.helpAudienceReturning: Only for those who have at least one previously closed ticket.
chatFlowAudience.helpAudienceCustom: Uses only the filters (tags, kanban, channels) without any newness criteria.
chatFlowAudience.helpMaxAgeDays: When set, defines how long (in days) since the contact was created they are still considered new. Empty = strict 'zero prior tickets' criteria.
chatFlowAudience.helpTagsInclude: The contact must have AT LEAST ONE of the listed tags. Empty = filter ignored.
chatFlowAudience.helpTagsExclude: The contact is rejected if they have ANY of the listed tags. Useful to block existing customers, for example.
chatFlowAudience.helpKanban: Restricts to a specific kanban column. 'Any column' = filter ignored.
chatFlowAudience.helpChannels: Restricts to selected channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, etc). Empty = all channels.
chatFlowAudience.helpPriority: When multiple chatflows pass the filters, the one with the highest priority wins. Ties broken by lower ID.
chatFlowAudience.helpHowItWorks: On every new ticket, the system iterates active chatflows by priority and picks the first one that passes all configured filters here. If none matches, it falls back to the channel's default chatflow — and if the default also has audience filters enabled, it only fires when the contact passes them; otherwise the conversation goes straight to your team, without the bot.
chatFlowAudience.helpOutOfAudience: If a flow with filters enabled ends up applied to a ticket whose contact is outside the audience, the bot releases the ticket to your team instead of staying silent. Business hours work differently: outside the time windows the bot just goes quiet and resumes in the next window.
chatFlowAudience.helpKeyword: If the chatflow also has a trigger word, BOTH must match (logical AND): the message must contain the word AND the contact must pass this audience.

relatorioAnunciosPage.metaErr_step_expired2: New conversations from the same ad will resend the click ID and should work.

relatorioAnunciosPage.metaErr_invalid_token_desc: Refresh the credential access token in Settings > Conversions > Credentials.
relatorioAnunciosPage.metaErr_step_token1: Generate a new system user token with ads_management permission in Meta Business.

relatorioAnunciosPage.metaErr_step_unknown2: Look up the fbtrace_id in Meta Events Manager diagnostics for more details.

oauthCustomDomainPage.warning2: If the license expires or the CNAME stops pointing to the proxy, the domain will be automatically removed on revalidation (every 3 days).
oauthCustomDomainPage.warning3: After saving, update the Redirect URI registered at each provider (LinkedIn Developer, Google Cloud, TikTok DevPortal, etc.) to use the new domain.
oauthCustomDomainPage.secretSectionDesc: Shared secret used by the backend when calling proxy registry endpoints (webhooks for Instagram, Messenger, WABA, WooCommerce, ML, OLX, LinkedIn, TikTok). Must match the proxy REGISTRY_SECRET.

googleReviews.apiNotApprovedStep1: Request access in the Google form (Business Profile API), using the email of an owner or manager of a listing.
googleReviews.apiNotApprovedStep2: Have a listing verified and active for more than 60 days, with a website registered.
googleReviews.apiNotApprovedStep3: Wait for Google's reply by email. After approval, reviews show up here on their own.

googleReviews.apiDisabledDesc: In the Google App's Google Cloud project, whoever manages it needs to enable My Business Account Management API, My Business Business Information API and Google My Business API. After that, reading resumes on its own.

googleReviews.apiQuotaDesc: Try again later. The automatic reading continues on its own.
googleReviews.apiErrorTitle: The last reading on Google failed
googleReviews.apiErrorDesc: The system tries again on its own. If it keeps failing, use Refresh now or connect the account again.
googleReviews.partialReadTitle: {count, plural, one {One Google account did not respond in the last read of the listings} other {# Google accounts did not respond in the last read of the listings}}
googleReviews.partialReadDesc: Google returned error {code} while fetching the listings. The listings from the accounts that responded are below and keep working. The system tries again on its own every 30 minutes; if the warning persists, use Refresh now and check in the Business Profile that the account still has access to the listings.
googleReviews.noActiveLocations: No listing is being tracked. Turn on a listing above to import its reviews.
googleReviews.filtersTip: The listing and period apply to the summary and to the list below.
googleReviews.connectionTip: Reviews are read from this Google account, which must be an owner or manager of the listings in the Business Profile. One account per company.
googleReviews.locationsTip: Turn on the listings the company wants to track. When turned on, older reviews are imported without alerts; only the ones that arrive afterwards show in the bell. When turned off, reading stops and the reviews already imported stay here.
googleReviews.locationsEmpty: No listing found in this Google account. Check that the account is an owner or manager of the listing in the Business Profile and connect again.
googleReviews.locationRating: {rating} average · {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} on Google
googleReviews.locationImportingTip: Older reviews of this listing are being brought in little by little and do not generate alerts.
googleReviews.locationErrorNotFound: Listing not found on Google (removed or no access)
googleReviews.locationErrorGeneric: Could not read this listing on the last attempt
googleReviews.locationErrorTip: The system tries again on its own on the next reading. The other listings keep working.
googleReviews.useReviewLink: Use this listing's link in the review request
googleReviews.useReviewLinkTip: Fills the Google review request link (Settings tab) with this listing's official link. It does not turn the request on by itself: the switch stays as it is.
googleReviews.useReviewLinkDone: Listing link saved in the review request
googleReviews.useReviewLinkDoneDesc: Check it in the Settings tab. The request is only sent to customers if the switch is on.
googleReviews.locationActivated: Listing turned on. Reviews show up after the next reading (use Refresh now to avoid waiting).
googleReviews.locationDeactivated: Listing turned off. Reviews already imported stay here.
googleReviews.disconnectDesc: This deletes the connection, the listings and all imported reviews from this panel. Nothing changes on Google: reviews and replies stay published. If you connect again, the reviews are imported again.
googleReviews.disconnectRevokeHint: To also remove the system's access to your Google account, open <link>myaccount.google.com/permissions</link> and remove the app.
googleReviews.disconnectLinkKept: The review request link (Settings tab) stays saved.
googleReviews.disconnected: Google account disconnected. The imported reviews were deleted from this panel.
googleReviews.manageOnlyHint: Only administrators and supervisors (or profiles with General settings) can connect, choose listings and change the alert.
googleReviews.alertTip: Notifies administrators and supervisors in the bell and by notification when a low-rated review stays unanswered past the deadline. Each review alerts only once, and only reviews that arrive after the listing starts being tracked count.
googleReviews.alertHoursInvalid: Enter a number of hours between 1 and 720.
googleReviews.alertSummary: Reviews of up to {stars, plural, one {# star} other {# stars}} unanswered for more than {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} trigger an alert.
googleReviews.alertDisabledNote: With the alert off, new reviews keep showing in the bell as new.
googleReviews.summaryRatingTip: Average and total that Google itself shows on the listings (all reviews, without the period filter).
googleReviews.summaryRatingDesc: {count, plural, one {# review on Google} other {# reviews on Google}}
googleReviews.summaryRatingDescMulti: {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} across {locations, plural, one {# listing} other {# listings}}
googleReviews.summaryPeriodCountTip: Imported reviews that match the listing and period filters above.
googleReviews.summaryUnansweredTip: Reviews still without a reply from the company, within the listing and period filters above.
googleReviews.summaryAvgResponseTip: Time between the review arriving and the company replying, for the replied reviews within the filters above.
googleReviews.starsDistributionTip: How many reviews of each rating match the filters above.
googleReviews.monthlyTip: Number of reviews and average rating per month, from the imported reviews. Months without reviews have no point in the average rating.
googleReviews.monthlyEmpty: No reviews in the last 12 months.
googleReviews.monthlyTableToggle: Show the numbers as a table
googleReviews.filterUnansweredTip: Shows only the reviews that do not have a reply from the company yet.
googleReviews.listEmptyDesc: Reviews of the active listings show up here after the reading. The first import can take a few minutes.
googleReviews.badgeNewTip: No one in the company has seen this review in this tab yet.
googleReviews.replyStatePendingTip: Google is reviewing the reply before showing it to the public. It usually takes a few minutes.
googleReviews.replyStateRejectedTip: Google did not publish this reply because it breaks its rules. Edit the text and publish again.
googleReviews.replyDialogDesc: The reply is public on Google, on behalf of the company, and replaces the previous reply to this review.
googleReviews.replyPlaceholder: Thank the reviewer and, if needed, explain what the company will do.
googleReviews.replyCounterTip: Google limits the size of the reply. Accented letters count as 2 and emojis as 4 toward this limit.
googleReviews.replyTooLong: Text above Google's limit. Shorten the reply to publish.
googleReviews.replyPublishedPending: Reply sent. Google may take a few minutes reviewing it before showing it to the public.
googleReviews.replyChangedNotice: The reply changed on Google after you opened this window. See the current version above; your text was kept.
googleReviews.replyDeleteTitle: Delete the reply to this review?
googleReviews.replyDeleteDesc: The reply disappears from Google for everyone. The review stays published and can be replied to again later.
googleReviews.replySuggestTip: Uses the AI configured in Copilot to write a polite draft in the language of the review. Review it before publishing: nothing goes to Google until you click Publish.
googleReviews.replySuggestDone: Suggestion inserted. Review it before publishing.
googleReviews.errNotConnected: The Google account is not connected. Connect again.
googleReviews.errSyncThrottled: The manual refresh can be used once every 5 minutes. Wait a little and try again.
googleReviews.errFrontendUrl: The panel address is not configured on the server. Notify the platform administrator.
googleReviews.errProxyOutdated: The Google connection service needs to be updated. Notify the platform administrator.
googleReviews.errStateInvalid: This connection request expired or was already used. Close this window and click Connect again.
googleReviews.errForbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
googleReviews.errReplyTooLong: The reply is longer than Google accepts. Shorten the text.
googleReviews.errReplyRejected: Google rejected the reply. Review the text and try again.
googleReviews.errReplyChanged: The reply to this review changed on Google (or someone else replied) after you opened it. We are showing the current version: review it and publish again if you want to replace it.
googleReviews.errReviewNotFound: This review no longer exists on Google (the author may have deleted it).
googleReviews.errGoogleApi: Google did not respond as expected. Try again in a few minutes.
googleReviews.errCopilotNoKey: No AI configured in Copilot. Configure Copilot to use the suggestion.
googleReviews.errNoGoogleApp: No Google App with the Business Profile service is available. Notify the platform administrator.
googleReviews.errPlatformAppDisabled: The platform Google App is turned off for this company. Notify the platform administrator.
googleReviews.errUnavailable: This feature is not available on this installation yet. Notify the platform administrator.
googleReviews.errReviewUrlInvalid: This listing's link is not valid for the review request.
googleReviews.errAuthExpired: Access to the Google account expired. Connect again.
googleReviews.errReplyInProgress: Someone else is publishing a reply to this review right now. Wait a moment and try again.
googleReviews.errSuggestFailed: The AI could not suggest a reply right now. Try again or write the reply.
googleReviews.callbackSuccess: {count, plural, =0 {Google account connected, but no listing was found in this account.} one {Google account connected. # listing found: turn it on in the Google tab of Reviews.} other {Google account connected. # listings found: turn on the ones you want to track in the Google tab of Reviews.}}

appGooglePage.helpCoverageBusiness: Google Business Profile: reviews of the listings (view and reply from the panel)
appGooglePage.helpBusinessI0: 1. In Google Cloud, enable My Business Account Management API, My Business Business Information API and Google My Business API in the same project as the app.

appGooglePage.helpBusinessI3: 4. On the OAuth consent screen, add the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage.
appGooglePage.helpBusinessI4: 5. Publish the app as In production. In testing mode, companies' access expires every 7 days and they have to connect again.
appGooglePage.helpBusinessI5: 6. Turn on the Google Business Profile service in this form.

rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_NOT_CONFIGURED: Rocket.Chat has not been set up for your company yet.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the Rocket.Chat server. Check the address and whether the server is online.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_HOST_BLOCKED: This address cannot be used as a Rocket.Chat server.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ADMIN_AUTH: Rocket.Chat rejected the integration account: the access token was revoked or is wrong.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_PERMISSION: The integration account does not have enough permissions in Rocket.Chat. Use an account with the admin role.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_TOKEN_SECRET_MISSING: The access release secret is missing. Rocket.Chat 8 or newer requires the same value as the server's CREATE_TOKENS_FOR_USERS_SECRET variable.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_TOKEN_SECRET_INVALID: Rocket.Chat refused to release access. Check that the secret matches the server's CREATE_TOKENS_FOR_USERS_SECRET (on version 7, the server needs CREATE_TOKENS_FOR_USERS=true), that Rocket.Chat was restarted after setting the variable and that the integration account has the user-generate-access-token permission.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_USER_NOT_FOUND: You do not have a Rocket.Chat account yet and automatic creation is turned off. Ask the administrator to create your account with the same email you use in the panel.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT: There is a Rocket.Chat account with your username or email that could not be confirmed as yours. For security, access was not released. Ask the administrator to check that account.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ACCOUNT_IS_ADMIN: The Rocket.Chat account linked to your email is an administrator account. For security, administrator accounts sign in directly through Rocket.Chat.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED: The Rocket.Chat account with your email does not have a confirmed email yet. Ask the Rocket.Chat administrator to confirm the email of that account.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Your Rocket.Chat account is deactivated. Ask the administrator to reactivate it.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_INVALID_USER_DATA: Rocket.Chat refused to create your account with the panel data (name, email or email domain).
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED: When changing the server address, enter the access token again and, if there is one, the access release secret.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_IFRAME_BLOCKED: Rocket.Chat does not allow being opened inside the panel. In Rocket.Chat, go to Administration > Settings > General and turn off Restrict access inside any Iframe.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_IFRAME_NOT_HTTPS: Rocket.Chat needs an https address to open inside the panel.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_IFRAME_RECEIVE_DISABLED: Rocket.Chat ignores the sign-in sent by the panel. In Iframe Integration, turn on Enable Receive and add this panel's address to Receive Origins (or use *), without spaces.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_IFRAME_SEND_DISABLED: Rocket.Chat does not tell the panel when sign-in finishes or when messages arrive. In Iframe Integration, turn on Enable Send and use this panel's address (or *) in Send Target Origin.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_INTERNAL: Rocket.Chat could not be opened because of an error in the panel. Try again; if it persists, contact support.

appRocketChatPage.serverUrlTooltip: Use the full https address, the same one the browser shows once Rocket.Chat is open. If the address takes you to another one, enter the final address.
appRocketChatPage.serverChangedNote: You changed the address: enter the access token again (and the secret, if there is one). For security, the saved values only work for the previous address.
appRocketChatPage.savedCredentialsNote: For security, the saved token and secret are not shown here. Leave the fields blank to keep what is saved, or type a new value to replace it.
appRocketChatPage.createTokensSecretTooltip: A password agreed between the panel and the Rocket.Chat server. From version 8 on, without it agents cannot enter the chat already logged in.
appRocketChatPage.autoCreateUsersNote: Each agent uses the Rocket.Chat account that has the same email registered in the panel, already confirmed. Rocket.Chat administrator accounts are never used. If the name is already taken or not allowed in Rocket.Chat, the new account gets a number at the end (e.g. maria.15).
appRocketChatPage.globalAccountsNote: In a global configuration, each company uses its own Rocket.Chat accounts, with the company code at the start of the name (e.g. t12.maria for company 12), so one company never enters another company's account. An old account without this code is no longer used: rename it in Rocket.Chat, adding the code in front.
appRocketChatPage.validateBtnTooltip: Checks, without saving, everything the chat needs: the server, the integration account, the permissions, the agents' login and whether Rocket.Chat opens inside the panel.
appRocketChatPage.testResultNote: The test uses what is filled in right now. Changes only apply to agents after you save.

bulkPhoneWarnings.title: Numbers possibly with wrong 9th digit

bulkPhoneWarnings.duplicatesHintMultiSend: Lines with the same recipient (after 9th-digit normalization). Each line produces a separate message (intentional use for different variables). If unintended, remove duplicates before sending.
bulkPhoneWarnings.behaviorInfo:
BR 9th-digit correction:
• Follows the company setting (Settings > General > Brazilian 9th digit convention).
• Area code rule: mobile DDD<30 with the 9; DDD>=30 without it; landlines untouched.
• Always with 9: mobile numbers always keep the 9th digit (never removed).
• Validate Contact off: numbers are never changed.

Behavior (all 4 bulk tabs):
• Duplicates (after normalization) are merged — you see which.
• Numbers diverging from the rule are flagged in a warning; send proceeds as typed.
• Variants of the same contact (with/without 9) are recognized as the same contact in the database.

instagramPkSanitize.title: Fix Instagram IGSID (>2^53)
instagramPkSanitize.description: Audits Instagram contacts with instagramPK corrupted by IEEE-754 overflow (>2^53) and corrects them by cross-referencing the Meta API.
instagramPkSanitize.warnBody:
This operation performs a direct UPDATE on Contacts.instagramPK.

reasons.hiddenParamReserved: This name is used by the form page itself (embed, ref, lang, sent, error). Choose another parameter.
reasons.optionQueue: The queue chosen in one of the options no longer exists. Choose another one.
reasons.optionTags: A tag chosen in one of the options no longer exists. Review the tags.

appearance.logoHint: Shown at the top of the form. Pick from the gallery or paste an address that starts with https.
appearance.coverHint: Banner at the top of the form. Pick from the gallery or paste an address that starts with https.
appearance.httpsOnly: Use an address that starts with https (other addresses are not accepted).
appearance.colorsHint: The main color is used for the button and the highlights; the background color is the color of the page around the form.
appearance.colorInvalid: Use the color code in the #RRGGBB format.
appearance.schemeHint: Automatic follows the light or dark mode on the device of the person who opens the form.
appearance.widthHint: Narrow works well for a few fields; wide, for fields side by side. On mobile, both take up the whole screen.
appearance.textsHint: The texts you write here appear as they are, without translation. The default texts (button, error messages) follow the language of the link or of the company's Region.
appearance.submitLabelHint: Empty = Submit, in the language of whoever opens the form.
appearance.successMessagePlaceholder: E.g.: We received your answers. We will get back to you soon.
appearance.successHint: Shown after the submission. Empty = a default message confirming receipt.
appearance.successWithRedirect: When the redirect link is filled in, the person goes straight to it and this message is not shown.
appearance.redirectHint: After submitting, the person goes to this address (for example, the thank-you page on your website). Only https addresses.
appearance.previewNote: The preview does not send anything

onSubmit.channelHint: The ticket opens in this channel and the agent replies through it. The customer's reply lands in the same ticket. The form does not count as a connection in your plan.
onSubmit.channelRequiredNote: Without a channel, the form is unavailable to anyone who opens the link.
onSubmit.channelInvalid: This channel no longer exists or is not supported. Choose another one.
onSubmit.noChannels: No supported channel found. Forms open tickets in WhatsApp, official WhatsApp and email channels.
onSubmit.officialChannelNote: Official channel: people who have never messaged you only receive the confirmation through an approved template.
onSubmit.emailChannelNote: Email channel: the ticket opens using the person's email and always goes to the queue.
onSubmit.fallbackEmailHint: For people who do not enter a phone: the ticket opens in this email channel. With the fallback, the person can enter only the phone or only the email.
onSubmit.fallbackOnNote: People who enter a phone go to the main channel; those who enter only an email go to the fallback.
onSubmit.fallbackOffNote: Without a fallback, the phone is required.
onSubmit.fallbackInvalid: This email channel no longer exists or cannot be used as a fallback. Choose another one.
onSubmit.noEmailChannels: No email channel connected to the company.
onSubmit.destinationHint: What happens to the ticket opened by the form. Tags and opportunity apply in all three destinations.
onSubmit.destinationQueueDesc: Enters the chosen queue (or the answer's queue) and the team handles it.
onSubmit.destinationFlowDesc: The chatbot flow starts when the customer replies.
onSubmit.destinationAgentDesc: The AI agent handles it when the customer replies, already knowing the answers.
onSubmit.emailForcesQueue: With an email channel, the ticket always goes to the queue: flow and AI agent do not run on email.
onSubmit.flowNotInPlan: The chatbot flow is not part of your company's plan.
onSubmit.agentNotInPlan: AI agents are not part of your company's plan.
onSubmit.flowRequired: Choose the flow the ticket starts in.
onSubmit.flowInvalid: The selected flow no longer exists. Choose another one.
onSubmit.flowStartsNote: The flow is set up in the ticket and starts at the customer's first message. Contacts with the chatbot blocked go to the fallback queue.
onSubmit.agentRequired: Choose the AI agent the ticket starts with.
onSubmit.agentInvalid: The selected agent no longer exists or is inactive. Choose another one.
onSubmit.noAgents: No active AI agent. Knowledge-base-only agents do not appear here.
onSubmit.agentStartsNote: The agent is set up in the ticket, reads the form answers and starts at the customer's first message. Contacts with the chatbot blocked go to the fallback queue.
onSubmit.queueHint: Queue for the new ticket. A list option with its own queue takes precedence over this one. Empty = the channel's default queue.
onSubmit.fallbackQueueHint: Receives people who end up in the email channel, people with the chatbot blocked and tickets where the flow or the agent cannot start. Empty = the channel's default queue.
onSubmit.queueInvalid: The selected queue no longer exists. Choose another one.
onSubmit.fallbackQueueRequired: With the email fallback, choose the queue for people who end up on email.
onSubmit.fallbackQueueNeeded: With the email fallback, this queue is required: email does not run flows or agents.
onSubmit.existingTicketHint: If the contact already has an open or pending ticket in this channel, the answers go into it without changing the queue or the owner, and the owner is notified. Queue, flow, agent and opportunity only apply to a new ticket.
onSubmit.tagsHint: The tags go to the contact (not to the ticket) and are added to the ones the contact already has.
onSubmit.tagsNote: Added to the tags of the answers with rules.
onSubmit.tagsInvalid: A selected tag no longer exists. Review the tags.
onSubmit.opportunityHint: Creates a pipeline opportunity for the contact when the form opens a new ticket. It starts with a value of zero, and the actions of the pipeline stage run just as they do for an opportunity created by hand.
onSubmit.opportunityNote: Only for a new ticket. The actions of the chosen stage (messages, tags) fire for it.
onSubmit.funnelNotInPlan: The funnel is not part of your company's plan: the opportunity will not be created.
onSubmit.pipelineInvalid: The selected pipeline no longer exists. Choose another one.
onSubmit.stageInvalid: The selected stage no longer exists or does not belong to this pipeline. Choose another one.
onSubmit.confirmationHint: Automatic message to the person who submitted, through the ticket channel. The full answers stay only on the ticket card, which the team sees.
onSubmit.confirmationNote: Sent once per submission, through the channel where the ticket opened.
onSubmit.confirmationNeedsChannel: Choose the channel to set up the confirmation.
onSubmit.officialWindowNote: Official channel: people who have never messaged you (or have not messaged you in more than 24 h) only receive the confirmation through an approved template. Without a template, the confirmation is only sent if the conversation is open.
onSubmit.templateHint: Optional. The template variables accept {vars} and the key of each field in double curly braces.
onSubmit.templateVarsRequired: Fill in all the template variables (an empty variable makes Meta reject the message).
onSubmit.emailSubjectHint: Used when the confirmation is sent by email. Empty = a default subject.
onSubmit.confirmationTextPlaceholder: Empty = default message confirming receipt, with the person's name and the form name
onSubmit.confirmationTextNote: Empty = default message in the language of the company's Region.
onSubmit.confirmationTextOfficialNote: On this channel, the text is only used without a template and with the conversation open in the last 24 h.
onSubmit.confirmationVarsHint: The variables with a dashed border are the fields of this form.
onSubmit.confirmationFallbackNote: People who end up on the email fallback receive the confirmation by email, with the subject above and this text.

share.slugHint: Last part of the link (/f/address). It is unique across the whole installation: two forms never have the same address.
share.slugTaken: Already in use by another form.
share.slugInvalid: Use 3 to 80 letters without accents, numbers and hyphens.
share.slugChangeNote: When you save, the old link stops working. Update it wherever it has already been shared.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
share.unsavedNote: There are unsaved changes: the link, the codes and the example below apply to the saved version.
share.inactiveNote: The form is inactive: anyone who opens the link sees that it is unavailable.
share.noChannelNote: Without a saved channel, the form is unavailable. Choose the channel under On submit and save.
share.qrHint: Pointing a phone camera at it opens the form. Good for printed material and service counters.
share.qrNote: Download the image in good resolution for printing.
share.qrDownloadFailed: Could not download the QR code image.
share.embedHint: Paste the code on the page of your website where the form should appear. There is no file to download: the code already contains everything.
share.embedDesc: The code with script adjusts the height on its own, passes on the hidden field parameters (like utm_source) and takes the person to the redirect link. Without script, the frame has a fixed height and does not pass on parameters.
share.embedNoScriptHint: For websites that do not accept scripts. Fixed height and no parameters passed on.
share.embedRecopyHint: You created or changed a hidden field: save and copy the code with script again to pass on the new parameter.
share.embedRecopyNote: When you create a new hidden field, copy the code with script again: the code keeps the parameter list from the moment it was copied.
share.externalSection: Submissions from other websites and systems
share.externalPostsHint: For the HTML form on your own website or a system that submits without a token. The anti-abuse protections still apply (limit per network address and 24-hour cap). For systems, prefer the API with a token.
share.externalPostsDesc: Off by default: only the form page and the embed code can submit.
share.externalOffNote: With the option off, any submission that does not come from the form page is rejected.
share.externalOnNote: On: any website can submit to the address below. The limit per network address and the 24-hour cap still apply.
share.endpointHint: Accepts the HTML form (POST method) and JSON. The field names are the keys in the list below.
share.fieldKeysHint: Use these keys as the field names in your HTML form or in the JSON. In lists, the value is the option identifier (the option text is also accepted).
share.multiselectValueHint: Several options: repeat the key, once for each option.
share.phoneValueHint: With the country code, for example +55 11 91234-5678. Without the +, the country of the company's Region is used.
share.htmlExampleHint: A starting point for your website: adjust the look as you like, but keep the field names and the hp_website field (a trap for bots: it must stay empty and hidden).
share.apiNote: To integrate a system securely, use the forms route of the API (with a token): it does not depend on this option and returns the created ticket.
share.apiIds: In the API forms route, this form is formId {id} or slug {slug}.
share.dailyLimitHint: Above the cap, new submissions from the page and from other websites are rejected until the count for the last 24 h goes down. Submissions through the API and suspicious ones do not count.
share.minFillHint: A submission made faster than this (common with bots and browser autofill) is stored as suspicious in Responses, without opening a ticket or sending a message. You can open the ticket from there.
share.minFillNote: Submissions in less than {seconds} s are marked as suspicious.
share.minFillOff: Off (0): no submission is marked as suspicious because of the time.
share.minFillInvalid: The minimum time ranges from 0 to {max} seconds.

responses.invalidRange: The start date cannot be after the end date.
responses.count: {count, plural, =0 {No responses} one {# response} other {# responses}}
responses.exportHint: The spreadsheet has the responses of the current filter, up to {max}. Values that start with =, +, - or @ get an apostrophe in front so the spreadsheet does not treat them as formulas.
responses.exportDone: {count, plural, one {# response exported} other {# responses exported}}.
responses.exportCapped: The spreadsheet stopped at {max} responses. Use the date filter to export the rest.
responses.exportFailed: Could not export right now. Try again.
responses.emptyBody: The form submissions appear here as soon as they arrive.
responses.emptyFilteredBody: Change the dates or the status, or clear the filters.

statusHints.received: arrived and will open the ticket in a moment
statusHints.failed: did not open the ticket; see the reason and try again
statusHints.suspect: submitted too fast and stored without opening a ticket
statusHints.skipped: contact blocked; nothing was opened or sent

confirmationHints.sent: The confirmation was handed to the ticket channel for sending. If the channel is down it may not reach the customer: check the conversation.
confirmationHints.skipped: Nothing was sent to the customer: on official WhatsApp without a template the 24-hour window was closed, or the text, the customer's email or a valid template was missing. The ticket opened normally.
confirmationHints.failed: The channel refused or could not send the confirmation (for example, a disconnected channel). The ticket opened normally, and the confirmation is not resent automatically.

responses.processTitle: Open a ticket for this submission?
responses.processBody: This submission arrived too fast and was stored as suspicious. Opening the ticket does everything a normal submission does: contact, tags, ticket, opportunity and customer confirmation.
responses.retryDone: Submission processed: the ticket was opened or updated.
responses.retrySkipped: The contact is blocked: nothing was opened or sent.
responses.retryPending: Submission being processed. Refresh in a few seconds.
responses.showAnswers: {count, plural, =0 {View answers} one {View # answer} other {View # answers}}
responses.suspectNote: Arrived before the minimum fill time. Nothing has been opened or sent yet.
responses.skippedNote: The contact is blocked. Nothing was opened or sent.

help.description: Public forms that open tickets: the person fills it in, the contact is created or completed, and the ticket opens in the chosen channel, with the answers on a card that only the team sees.
help.what1: Each form has its own fields, channel, queue and tags. Create one per topic (quotes, support, jobs).
help.what2: The form is not a new channel and does not count as a connection in your plan: the ticket opens in the WhatsApp, official WhatsApp or email channel you choose, and the customer's reply lands in the same ticket.
help.what3: Each submission is stored in Responses, with a date filter and export to a spreadsheet.
help.publish1: Under Share: copy the link (/f/address), download the QR code or copy the embed code for your website.
help.publish2: The embed code has no file to download and passes on the hidden field parameters (like utm_source). Created a new hidden field? Copy the code again.
help.publish3: For the HTML form on your website or a system without a token, turn on Accept submissions from other websites. For systems with a token, use the forms route of the API.
help.submit1: The contact is found only by the channel identity (the phone on WhatsApp, the email on an email channel) or created. For an existing contact, only what was empty is filled in, and the tags are added.
help.submit2: A new ticket follows the chosen destination (queue, flow or AI agent) and can get a pipeline opportunity. Flow and agent start when the customer replies.
help.submit3: If a ticket is already open in the channel, the answers go into it without changing the queue or the owner.
help.submit4: The team is notified as with an incoming message. The customer confirmation is optional; on the official channel, people who have never messaged you only receive it through a template.
help.care1: The form is public: anyone can type someone else's phone number. That is why nothing already saved on the contact is replaced.
help.care2: A submission made too fast is marked as suspicious, without opening a ticket; you can open the ticket from the Responses page.
help.care3: Changing the address breaks the old link, and deleting the form erases the stored responses (the cards in the tickets remain).
help.care4: A blocked contact does not open a ticket or receive messages: the submission is marked as skipped.
